makaleler.baslik: Subtotal Colectomy vs Total Colectomy for Slow-Transit Constipation: 1-Year Outcomes of the STOPS Randomized Clinical Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yavaş Geçişli Kabızlıkta Subtotal ve Total Kolektomi Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Yavaş geçişli kabızlığı olan 252 hastanın dahil olduğu multicenter RCT'de, 12. ayda Wexner Constipation Score yönünden SC-CRA, TC-IRA'ya noninferior bulundu (ortalama skorlar sırasıyla 7,01 ve 6,84; p=0,02). 3. ayda erken evre inkontinans SC-CRA grubunda daha düşüktü (%8,7'ye karşı %21,4; p=0,01), ancak 1 yıllık hasta memnuniyeti TC-IRA grubunda daha yüksekti (%97,5'e karşı %95,8; p=0,03).
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: For patients with slow-transit constipation (STC), total colectomy with ileorectal anastomosis (TC-IRA) remains the standard surgical treatment but is frequently complicated by diarrhea, fecal incontinence, and bowel obstruction. Subtotal colectomy with cecorectal anastomosis (SC-CRA) has emerged as a promising alternative; however, recurrence of constipation remains a critical concern. High-quality evidence comparing these 2 procedures is lacking.
OBJECTIVE: To compare the 1-year Wexner Constipation Score of patients with STC who underwent SC-CRA vs TC-IRA.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This multicenter, open-label, noninferiority randomized clinical trial was conducted at 12 tertiary hospitals across 8 provinces in China from April 2022 to April 2025, with 12-month follow-up (final follow-up April 2026). Eligible participants were adults aged 18 years or older with Rome IV-defined functional constipation, fewer than 1 spontaneous bowel movement per week, and long-term laxative dependence, defined as the regular use of osmotic or stimulant laxatives, or prokinetic agents, at least 3 times weekly for 6 months or longer before enrollment. Of 272 adults assessed, 252 were randomized. These data were analyzed from March 2025 to March 2026.
INTERVENTIONS: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to undergo either SC-CRA or TC-IRA.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was the Wexner Constipation Score (WCS) at 12 months, with a prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.32 points. Secondary outcomes included fecal incontinence, morbidity, quality of life, and patient-reported satisfaction.
RESULTS: A total of 252 participants (mean age, 49.5 years; 221 female [87.7%] and 31 male [12.3%]) were randomized to undergo SC-CRA (n = 126) or TC-IRA (n = 126). At 12 months, adjusted mean (SD) WCS was 7.01 (3.31) in the SC-CRA group and 6.84 (3.68) in the TC-IRA group (adjusted mean difference, 0.17; 95% CI, -0.93 to 1.27), which fell within the prespecified noninferiority margin of 1.32 (P = .02 for noninferiority). Early postoperative incontinence at 3 months was less frequent in the SC-CRA group than in the TC-IRA group (8.7% vs 21.4%; risk difference, -12.7%; 95% CI, -21.4% to -4.0%; P = .01). Perioperative morbidity did not differ significantly between groups (10.3% vs 12.7%; risk difference, -2.4%; 95% CI, -10.3% to 5.5%; P = .41), and quality-of-life scores at 12 months were comparable. However, patient-reported satisfaction at 12 months favored the TC-IRA group (97.5% vs 95.8%; P = .03).
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this randomized clinical trial among patients with refractory STC, SC-CRA was noninferior to TC-IRA with respect to the WCS at 12 months, but patient-reported satisfaction at 1 year was higher in the TC-IRA group. Longer-term follow-up is needed.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05352074.

makaleler.baslik: Long-term oncological outcomes of robotic versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision for rectal cancer: COLRAR randomized clinical trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum Kanserinde Robotik ve Laparoskopik TME: COLRAR Çalışması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: T1-4a rektum kanserli 295 hastanın incelendiği RCT'nin 5 yıllık sonuçlarında, R-TME ve L-TME benzer genel sağkalım (%92,6'ya karşı %92,4; p=0,838) ve relaps içermeyen sağkalım (%81,9'a karşı %83,0; p=0,801) gösterdi. Neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapi alan 146 hastadaki post-hoc analitik alt grupta, robotik cerrahi ile 5 yıllık lokal nükssüz sağkalım %98,6'ya karşı %90,7 bulundu (p=0,039).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Long-term oncological equivalence of robotic total mesorectal excision (R-TME) and laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (L-TME) remains unproven. The 5-year outcomes of the COLRAR RCT are reported.
METHODS: Adults with cT1-4a Nx M0 rectal adenocarcinoma within 10 cm of the anal verge were randomized 1 : 1 to L-TME or R-TME at three Korean tertiary centres between July 2011 and February 2016. Pre-specified secondary endpoints were 5-year overall, relapse-free, local recurrence-free, and distant recurrence-free survival. Analyses were on a modified intention-to-treat basis.
RESULTS: Of 295 analysed patients (144 L-TME patients and 151 R-TME patients; median follow-up of 72.6 months), 5-year overall survival (92.6% versus 92.4%; P = 0.838) and relapse-free survival (81.9% versus 83.0%; P = 0.801) were similar. Local recurrence occurred in 4.9% (L-TME) and 1.3% (R-TME); 5-year local recurrence-free and distant recurrence-free survival did not differ (P = 0.076 and P = 0.655). In a post-hoc analysis of 146 patients who received neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, 5-year local recurrence-free survival was 98.6% in R-TME patients versus 90.7% in L-TME patients (P = 0.039).
CONCLUSION: R-TME and L-TME produced equivalent 5-year oncological outcomes. A post-hoc analysis suggested improved local control with robotic surgery after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, requiring confirmation in prospectively designed studies.
REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT01423214 (http://www.clinicaltrials.gov).

makaleler.baslik: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: dMMR Kolon Kanserinde Neoadjuvan İmmünoterapi Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 111 hastanın dahil edildiği çok merkezli faz 2 NICHE-2 çalışmasında, rezeke edilebilir dMMR kolon kanserinde cerrahi öncesi ipilimumab ve nivolumab tedavisi uygulandı. 3 yıllık disease-free survival %100 ve 5 yıllık overall survival %100 olarak bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade induces high pathological response rates in patients with locally advanced mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) colon cancer, yet long-term survival outcomes have not been established. Previously, we reported safety (a primary endpoint) and pathological response (a secondary endpoint) data from the NICHE-2 trial. Here, we report the primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival and the exploratory endpoint of 5-year overall survival.
METHODS: In this single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial, patients with previously untreated, clinical stage 2 or 3, resectable dMMR colon cancer received a single dose of intravenous ipilimumab (1 mg per kg) on day 1, and two doses of intravenous nivolumab (3 mg per kg) on days 1 and 15, followed by surgery in one of the six participating hospitals in the Netherlands. Here, we report the independent primary efficacy endpoint of 3-year disease-free survival (time from surgery until disease recurrence or death from any cause) and the secondary endpoint of circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) analysis. Overall survival (time from study enrolment until death from any cause) is reported as an exploratory post-hoc analysis. All endpoints were assessed in the per-protocol population (patients who met the eligibility criteria and received at least one cycle of therapy). The study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03026140, and has completed accrual.
FINDINGS: From July 4, 2017, to July 18, 2022, 123 patients were screened, of whom 115 were treated and 111 were included in the per-protocol population. At the data cutoff (June 19, 2026), the postoperative median follow-up was 58·7 months (IQR 49·0-72·9). The 3-year disease-free survival was 100% (97·5% CI 100-100). After a median follow-up of 60·4 months (IQR 50·6-74·1), calculated from time of study enrolment, the 5-year overall survival was 100% (95% CI 100-100). In patients with available plasma samples, ctDNA was detected in 99 (92%) of 108 patients at baseline, and ctDNA clearance was observed in 44 (45%) of 98 patients after the first cycle in week 2 and in 80 (82%) of 97 patients after the second cycle before surgery. In patients with a pathological near-complete response and complete response, presurgery ctDNA clearance was observed in 19 (70%) of 27 patients and 60 (92%) of 65 patients, respectively. Assessment for minimal residual disease after surgery revealed that all patients were ctDNA negative.
INTERPRETATION: In patients with locally advanced dMMR colon cancer, treatment with ipilimumab and nivolumab before surgery resulted in a 3-year disease-free survival and 5-year overall survival of 100%. These findings support neoadjuvant nivolumab plus ipilimumab as a potential standard of care for patients with locally advanced dMMR colon cancer.
FUNDING: Bristol Myers Squibb.

makaleler.baslik: Neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy followed by camrelizumab and chemotherapy versus standard of care for locally advanced rectal cancer (UNION): a prespecified interim analysis of a multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Lokal İleri Rektum Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Kemoradyoterapi ve Camrelizumab Kombinasyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 231 hastanın katıldığı açık etiketli faz 3 UNION çalışmasında, kısa süreli radyoterapi ve takip eden camrelizumab artı CAPOX tedavisi, standart kola kıyasla 3 yıllık EFS oranını anlamlı düzeyde artırmıştır (%91,3'e karşı %77,4; HR 0,33, p=0,0029).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: To our knowledge, UNION is the first phase 3 trial to assess a neoadjuvant strategy incorporating radiotherapy, immunotherapy, and chemotherapy compared with standard care in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer, which reported positive results for the primary endpoint (blinded independent review committee [BIRC]-assessed pathological complete response rate; 39·8% vs 15·3%). Here, we present a prespecified interim analysis of event-free survival.
METHODS: This open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial was conducted at nine hospitals in China. Eligible patients were aged 18-75 years with untreated cT3-4 or N+ rectal adenocarcinoma (≤10 cm distance from the anal verge) and an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1. Patients were randomly assigned (1:1; stratified by clinical T stage and N stage), using permuted blocks, to receive neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy (25 Gy in five fractions) followed by two cycles of intravenous camrelizumab (200 mg on day 1) plus CAPOX (oral capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice daily on days 1-14 and intravenous oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 on day 1; experimental group) or long-course chemoradiotherapy (50·4 Gy in 28 fractions with concurrent oral capecitabine 825 mg/m2 twice daily) followed by two cycles of CAPOX (standard-of-care group). After surgery, both groups received six cycles of adjuvant CAPOX, and the experimental group additionally received adjuvant camrelizumab for up to 15 cycles. The primary endpoint was BIRC-assessed pathological complete response rate in the intention-to-treat population, which has been previously reported. Here, we performed a prespecified interim analysis of investigator-assessed event-free survival (one of the key secondary endpoints, defined as time from randomisation to radiographic progression precluding surgery, local recurrence or distant metastasis, or death) in the intention-to-treat population (all randomly assigned patients) with a boundary of a two-sided p values less than 0·0102. Safety was evaluated in all patients who received at least one dose of the study treatment according to the assigned regimen. The study was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04928807, and is active, but no longer recruiting.
FINDINGS: Between July 23, 2021, and March 1, 2023, 231 patients (153 [66%] males and 78 [34%] females; 227 [98%] were Han Chinese, and four [2%] were other ethnicity Chinese) were randomly assigned to the experimental group (n=113) and standard-of-care group (n=118). As of Oct 1, 2025, the median follow-up duration was 36·7 months (IQR 32·6-39·9) in the experimental group and 34·7 months (31·1-39·1) in the standard-of-care group. The 3-year investigator-assessed event-free survival rate was 91·3% (95% CI 83·9-95·4) in the experimental group versus 77·4% (67·9-84·4) in the standard-of-care group (stratified hazard ratio 0·33 [0·15-0·71]; two-sided log-rank p=0·0029). During the entire treatment period, the most common grade 3 or 4 treatment-related adverse events were decreased lymphocyte count (23 [20%] of 115 in the experimental group vs 31 [28%] of 112 in the standard-of-care group), decreased white blood cell count (13 [11%] vs 16 [14%]), decreased neutrophil count (13 [11%] vs 13 [12%]), and decreased platelet count (seven [6%] vs 15 [13%]). Treatment-related serious adverse events occurred in 22 (19%) versus 15 (13%) patients, with the most common being decreased platelet count (one [1%] vs six [5%]), and radiation gastroenteritis (two [2%] vs four [4%]). Treatment-related deaths occurred in one patient in the experimental group (septic shock related to chemotherapy, but unrelated to camrelizumab) and none in the standard-of-care group.
INTERPRETATION: In this interim analysis, short-course radiotherapy followed by camrelizumab and CAPOX significantly improved 3-year event-free survival in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer, with a safety profile similar to long-course chemoradiotherapy followed by CAPOX. Comparison of this promising new treatment strategy with contemporary total neoadjuvant therapy strategies is warranted.

makaleler.baslik: Technical overview and clinical outcomes of transabdominal strategies to eliminate or neutralize staple-line intersection during low anterior resection: a systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Low Anterior Reseksiyonda Zımba Hattı Kesişmesini Önleme Teknikleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: LAR sırasında zımba hattı kesişmesini önleyen transabdominal tekniklerin değerlendirildiği 17 çalışmalık (998 hasta) sistematik derlemede, anastomotik leak oranları mDST gruplarında %3,1 ile %3,9 (agrega %3,6) ve aSST grubunda %6,0 olarak raporlandı. Koruyucu stoma kullanımı mDST'de %6,2, aSST'de %33,1 oranında gerçekleşti.
makaleler.ozet:
AIM: To systematically classify and describe transabdominal surgical techniques designed to eliminate or neutralize staple-line intersection during low anterior resection (LAR), and to summarize their reported clinical outcomes.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261368367). Major databases were searched for studies describing transabdominal techniques aimed at eliminating or neutralizing staple-line intersection in colorectal anastomosis during LAR. Both modified double-stapling techniques (mDST) and abdominal single-stapled techniques (aSST) were included. Outcomes of interest included anastomotic leak (AL), use of protective stoma, and perioperative variables. Reported outcomes were descriptively summarized, and exploratory aggregated analyses were performed when appropriate.
RESULTS: Seventeen studies (998 patients) were included. Ten studies (529 patients) evaluated mDST (suture-based: n = 192; invagination-based: n = 337), while seven studies (469 patients) assessed aSST. Reported AL rates remained low across both mDST subgroups (3.1% suture-based vs 3.9% invagination-based), with an aggregated rate of 3.6%. The aSST group showed a leak rate of 6.0%. Protective stomas were used in 6.2% of mDST and 33.1% of aSST. Neoadjuvant therapy was used in 20.7% of aSST and 11.9% of mDST. Considerable heterogeneity in study design, technique, and outcome reporting was observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Transabdominal techniques that eliminate or neutralize staple-line intersection appear feasible and associated with low anastomotic leak rates. Modified DST techniques appear technically feasible and have been associated with low reported leak rates. However, owing to the heterogeneity of the available evidence, comparative findings should be considered exploratory.

tez.baslik: Rektum kanseri nedeni ile opere olan hastaların distal cerrahi sınırın lokal nükse ve surveye etkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Rektum Kanserinde Distal Cerrahi Sınırın Lokal Nüka ve Sağkalıma Etkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Mersin Üniversitesi'nde rektum kanseri nedeniyle opere edilen 372 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, üç ana distal cerrahi sınır grubu arasında lokal nüks, DFS ve OS açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır; ancak ≤0,3 cm gibi çok dar sınırlarda lokal nüks ve DFS sonuçları daha kötü bulunmuştur.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, rektum kanseri nedeniyle küratif rezeksiyon uygulanan hastalarda distal cerrahi sınır (DCS) uzunluğunun lokal nüks, hastalıksız sağkalım (DFS) ve genel sağkalım (OS) üzerine etkisini değerlendirmektir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu retrospektif kohort çalışmasına, Ocak 2010 ile Ocak 2025 tarihleri arasında Mersin Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde rektum kanseri nedeniyle küratif rezeksiyon uygulanan 372 hasta dahil edildi. Hastalar patoloji raporunda belirtilen distal cerrahi sınır uzunluğuna göre üç gruba ayrıldı: ≤1 cm, >1–2 cm ve >2 cm. Tüm olgular neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapi ve/veya total neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası opere edildi. Demografik özellikler, tümörün anal vergeye uzaklığı, cerrahi ve patolojik bulgular, komplikasyonlar, lokal nüks, uzak nüks, mortalite, DFS ve OS verileri değerlendirildi. Sağkalım analizlerinde Kaplan–Meier yöntemi ve log-rank testi, prognostik faktörlerin incelenmesinde Cox regresyon analizi kullanıldı. Bulgular: Hastaların medyan yaşı 64 yıl olup medyan takip süresi 87 aydı. Gruplar arasında yaş ve Charlson komorbidite indeksi açısından anlamlı fark saptanmazken, anal vergeye uzaklık anlamlı olarak farklıydı ve ≤1 cm grubunda tümörler daha distal yerleşimliydi. pT ve pN evresi ile çıkarılan lenf nodu sayısı gruplar arasında anlamlı farklılık gösterdi. Lokal nüks oranı ≤1 cm grubunda sayısal olarak daha yüksek bulunmakla birlikte bu fark istatistiksel anlamlılığa ulaşmadı. Kaplan–Meier analizinde distal cerrahi sınır grupları arasında lokal nüks açısından anlamlı fark saptanmadı; ancak 5 yıllık kümülatif lokal nüks oranı ≤1 cm grubunda daha yüksekti. DFS ve OS açısından üç ana grup arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark bulunmadı. Çok değişkenli analizde ileri yaş, ileri pT evresi ve lenfovasküler invazyon DFS açısından; ileri yaş, ileri pT evresi, lenfovasküler invazyon ve perinöral invazyon ise OS açısından olumsuz prognostik faktörler olarak saptandı. ≤1 cm alt grubunun kendi içinde yapılan analizde, özellikle ≤0.3 cm olan olgularda lokal nüks ve DFS sonuçlarının belirgin olarak daha kötü olduğu görüldü. Sonuç: Rektum kanserinde distal cerrahi sınır, tek başına mutlak bir prognostik belirleyici değildir. Üç ana grup arasında lokal nüks, DFS ve OS açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamış olmakla kısa distal sınır grubunda lokal nüks eğilimi daha yüksek bulunmuştur. Özellikle milimetrik düzeydeki çok dar sınırlar lokal kontrol ve hastalıksız sağkalım açısından risk oluşturabilir. Buna karşın prognozu esas olarak ileri yaş, ileri pT evresi, lenfovasküler invazyon ve perinöral invazyon gibi tümör biyolojisini yansıtan faktörler belirlemektedir. Distal cerrahi sınır, cerrahi kalite, CRM durumu, tümör evresi ve biyolojik risk faktörleri ile birlikte çok boyutlu olarak değerlendirilmelidir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Rektum kanseri, distal cerrahi sınır, lokal nüks, hastalıksız sağkalım, genel sağkalım, total mezorektal eksizyon

makaleler.baslik: Indocyanine green fluorescence cholangiography versus intraoperative cholangiography for laparoscopic cholecystectomy: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Kolesistektomide ICG-FC ve IOC Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 494 hastayı içeren 3 RCT'nin meta-analizinde, ICG-FC ve geleneksel IOC safra yolu görüntülemesinde benzer bulunmuştur (RR 1,02; p=0,22). ICG-FC, kolanjiografi süresini 3,90 dakika kısaltmış ve işlem başarısızlığını azaltmıştır (RR 0,08; p=0,01). Safra yolu yaralanması bildirilmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Bile duct injury during laparoscopic cholecystectomy is mainly related to misidentification of extrahepatic biliary anatomy. This systematic review and meta-analysis compared indocyanine green fluorescence cholangiography (ICG-FC) with conventional intraoperative X-ray cholangiography (IOC) for biliary visualization, procedural efficiency, technical success, surgeon satisfaction, and perioperative safety. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and CENTRAL were searched without restrictions. Eligible studies were randomized controlled trials comparing ICG-FC with conventional IOC in adults undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy. The primary outcome was successful visualization of extrahepatic biliary anatomy. Secondary outcomes included cholangiography failure, cholangiography duration, total operative time, surgeon satisfaction, choledocholithiasis detection, perioperative complications, morbidity, conversion to open surgery, and bile duct injury. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane RoB 2 tool, and random-effects models were applied. Three RCTs including 494 patients were included. Overall biliary visualization did not differ significantly between ICG-FC and IOC (RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.99-1.07; P = 0.22; I2 = 0%), including CBD (RR 1.08, 95% CI 0.99-1.18), cystic duct (RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.96-1.09), critical junction (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.90-1.07), and CHD visualization (RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.93-1.10). ICG-FC significantly reduced cholangiography failure (RR 0.08, 95% CI 0.01-0.58; P = 0.01) and cholangiography duration (MD - 3.90 min, 95% CI - 5.36 to - 2.44; P < 0.00001). Surgeon usability favored ICG-FC (SMD 0.88, 95% CI 0.09-1.68; P = 0.03), while total operative time (MD - 1.30 min, 95% CI - 6.76 to 4.15; P = 0.64), choledocholithiasis detection (RR 1.29, 95% CI 0.51-3.27; P = 0.59), postoperative complications (RR 0.80, 95% CI 0.22-2.91; P = 0.73), morbidity (RR 1.61, 95% CI 0.43-5.98; P = 0.48), and conversion to open surgery (RR 0.23, 95% CI 0.04-1.36; P = 0.11) were comparable. No bile duct injuries were recorded. ICG-FC provides biliary visualization comparable to IOC while improving technical success and reducing cholangiography duration. Large multicentre randomized controlled trials are required to determine whether these technical advantages reduce bile duct injury.

makaleler.baslik: Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma: A Review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İntrahepatik Kolanjiokarsinom Derlemesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: İntrahepatik kolanjiokarsinom tedavisinde cerrahi rezeksiyon temel tedavi olmaya devam etmektedir. Yüksek riskli vakalarda neoadjuvan kemoterapi, ileri evrede ise gemsitabin/sisplatin artı durvalumab veya pembrolizumab ilk basamak tedavi olarak önerilmektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) is the second most common primary liver malignancy, and incidence is increasing worldwide. Despite advances in multimodal therapy, 5-year overall survival remains approximately 9%, underscoring the urgent need for improved therapeutic strategies and comprehensive understanding of current management approaches.
OBSERVATIONS: Surgical resection with regional lymphadenectomy remains the cornerstone of curative therapy, with adjuvant capecitabine established as standard of care after resection. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy may be strongly considered for patients with iCCA with high-risk features, including at least 1 of the following: tumor size larger than 5 cm, multifocal disease, vascular invasion, lymph node involvement, and elevated carbohydrate antigen 19-9. For unresectable, liver-confined disease, locoregional therapies, including transarterial chemoembolization, Y-90 radioembolization, hepatic artery infusion pump chemotherapy, thermal ablation, and radiotherapy, may provide meaningful survival benefits. Liver transplant is emerging as a viable option in highly selected patients with very early iCCA or sustained response to neoadjuvant therapy. In advanced disease, chemoimmunotherapy with gemcitabine/cisplatin plus durvalumab or pembrolizumab has become the first-line treatment. Comprehensive molecular profiling identifies actionable targets in 30% to 40% of patients, including FGFR2 fusions/rearrangements, IDH1 variants, and other alterations amenable to targeted therapies approved by the US Food and Drug Administration.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The management of iCCA has evolved substantially with neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy for high-risk resectable disease, enhanced locoregional strategies for liver-confined tumors, chemoimmunotherapy as first-line systemic therapy for advanced disease, and precision oncology approaches targeting recurrent molecular alterations. Multidisciplinary evaluation and comprehensive genomic profiling are essential for optimal patient outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: The Clinical Significance of Hyperkinetic Biliary Dyskinesia on HIDA Scan: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HIDA Taramasında Hiperkinetik Biliyer Diskinezi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 14 retrospektif çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde 686 hasta incelenmiştir. Kolesistektomi sonrasında hastaların %83,1'inde semptomların tamamen kaybolduğu ve %91,6'sında düzelme olduğu bildirilmiştir. Cerrahi örneklerin %85,1'inde kronik kolesistit saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Hyperkinetic biliary dyskinesia, defined as a gallbladder ejection fraction (EF) ≥80% on cholecystokinin (CCK)-stimulated hepatobiliary iminodiacetic acid scans in the setting of biliary-type pain, has been increasingly recognized as a potential functional gallbladder disorder. The clinical significance of this entity and the role of cholecystectomy remain uncertain.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies reporting outcomes in patients with CCK-hepatobiliary iminodiacetic acid EF ≥80% who underwent cholecystectomy due to non-acute biliary-type pain. Primary outcomes included mean EF, rates of symptom resolution and improvement following cholecystectomy, and prevalence of chronic cholecystitis on pathology. Secondary outcomes included normal histology rates and symptom reproduction with CCK stimulation. All statistical analyses were conducted in R (version 4.5.0) using a random-effects model to obtain pooled estimates.
RESULTS: A total of 14 retrospective studies, including 686 patients, were analyzed. The pooled mean gallbladder EF was 90.27% (95% CI: 88.73-91.80, I2 = 86.6%). Symptom resolution occurred in 83.1% (95% CI: 76.7-89.4, I2 = 76.8%), and symptom improvement in 91.6% (95% CI: 89.0-94.2, I2 = 29.7%) of patients following cholecystectomy. Histopathologic analysis revealed chronic cholecystitis in 85.1% (95% CI: 76.9-93.4, I2 = 90.6%) of surgical specimens, while normal gallbladder histology was rare, observed in only 9.9% (95% CI: 4.6-15.2, I2 = 83.7%). The pooled risk ratio indicated a 6.70-fold higher likelihood of chronic cholecystitis compared with normal histology (95% CI: 3.69-12.17, I2 = 65.2%, P = 0.0022). Functional reproduction of symptoms during CCK stimulation was frequent, with a pooled rate of 78.3% (95% CI: 70.4-86.3, I2 = 35.6%). Egger regression test suggested potential publication bias for the normal histology outcome (P = 0.0223), but not for symptom resolution (P = 0.1589).
CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis suggests that a high gallbladder EF in the setting of biliary-type pain could represent clinically relevant hyperkinetic biliary dyskinesia rather than normal physiology. Cholecystectomy appears to provide meaningful symptom relief in appropriately selected patients, and pathologic findings frequently indicate underlying chronic inflammation. Further studies are needed to establish clear diagnostic cutoffs and guide management.

makaleler.baslik: Clinical value of C-reactive protein as a predictor of conversion of laparoscopic cholecystectomy to open surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Kolesistektomide Preoperatif CRP'nin Yeri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 11 çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde, açık cerrahiye konversiyon gereken hastaların preoperatif CRP düzeyleri anlamlı yüksek bulunmuştur (SMD 1,09; p<0,001). CRP'deki her 1 birimlik artış konversiyon riskini artırmıştır (OR 1,012; p=0,004).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is the gold standard for gallbladder disease, yet conversion to open surgery remains a challenge. Unplanned conversion from laparoscopic cholecystectomy to open surgery is associated with increased morbidity and potential patient safety risks. Accurate preoperative predictors may improve surgical planning and enhance patient safety. This meta-analysis evaluates the utility of preoperative C-reactive protein (CRP) as an objective biomarker for risk stratification.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA guidelines. The search was performed in PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus. We included studies reporting preoperative CRP in converted vs. non-converted laparoscopic cholecystectomy cases. Pooled standardized mean differences (SMD) and odds ratios (OR) were calculated using random-effects meta-analysis models using R version 4.3.3.
RESULTS: Eleven studies were included. The primary SMD analysis comprised 11 studies and a secondary analysis included 5 studies reporting per-unit OR. Patients requiring conversion had significantly higher preoperative CRP levels (SMD = 1.09, 95% CI: 0.77-1.41, p < 0.001). Each one-unit increase in CRP was significantly associated with a higher conversion risk (OR: 1.012; 95% CI 1.005-1.018; p = 0.004); the equivalent OR per 10 mg/L was 1.127 (95% CI: 1.051-1.209).
CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis demonstrated an association between elevated preoperative CRP and increased risk of conversion from laparoscopic to open cholecystectomy. CRP measurement may aid preoperative risk stratification when interpreted alongside clinical context.

makaleler.baslik: Association Between Intraoperative Blood Loss Adjusted for Body Size and Postoperative Complication Risk After Hepatectomy: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Hepatektomi Sonrası Kan Kaybı ve Komplikasyon İlişkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: HCC nedeniyle hepatektomi yapılan 2043 hastanın retrospektif analizinde, kan kaybı oranının (BLR) AUROC değeri 0,706 olarak bulunmuştur. Anatomik rezeksiyon grubunda yüksek BLR, şiddetli komplikasyon oranını %19,1'e çıkarmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: While increased intraoperative blood loss (IBL) during hepatectomy has been associated with poorer surgical outcomes, variations in patient body size can obscure the impact of IBL on complications. This study aimed to clarify the relationship between body size-adjusted IBL and complications and to identify clinically relevant thresholds for IBL.
METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted using a multicenter database of 2,043 patients who underwent hepatectomy for hepatocellular carcinoma. IBL was adjusted by body size factors, including total blood volume (TBV). The IBL/TBV ratio, defined as the blood loss ratio (BLR), was identified as the optimal body size-adjusted marker based on the highest absolute |z|-statistic.
RESULTS: The AUROC for BLR (0.706) was slightly higher than that for unadjusted IBL (0.698), although the absolute improvement in discrimination was modest. In multivariable analysis incorporating operative complexity and calendar year, operative time and Albumin-Bilirubin score were significantly associated with severe postoperative complications. A significant interaction was observed between BLR and anatomical resection (AR) (P for interaction = 0.008), whereas the interaction between BLR and laparoscopic surgery was not statistically significant (P for interaction = 0.205). In the AR group, high BLR (cutoff 13.1%) was associated with a severe complication rate (CD ≥3) of 19.1%, compared with 6.5% for low BLR. In the non-AR group, complication rates were 25.0% for high BLR (cutoff 15.0%) and 4.0% for low BLR.
CONCLUSION: This study suggested that BLR may provide a clinically interpretable, body size-adjusted measure of intraoperative blood loss associated with postoperative complication risk. The association between BLR and severe postoperative complications differed according to anatomical resection status, supporting consideration of surgical context when interpreting BLR.

tez.baslik: Ana safra kanalı bağlanmış sıçanlarda bevacizumabın karaciğerüzerine etkilerinin deneysel olarak değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Ana Safra Kanalı Bağlanan Sıçanlarda Bevacizumabın Karaciğere Etkileri
tez.kisa_ozet: Deneysel kolestatik karaciğer hasarı oluşturulan 32 Sprague Dawley erkek sıçan üzerinde yürütülen çalışmada, bevacizumab uygulaması karaciğer dokusunda ek hasar oluşturmadı ve inflamasyon ile fibrozis parametrelerinde olumlu etkiler gösterdi. AST, ALP, GGT, total ve direkt bilirubin düzeylerinde tedavi lehine düzelme eğilimi izlenmesine rağmen istatistiksel anlamlılığa ulaşılmadı.
tez.ozet: Karaciğer metastazları, özellikle kolorektal kanser başta olmak üzere birçok malignitenin ileri evrelerinde görülebilmekte ve kolestatik karaciğer hasarına neden olabilmektedir. Metastatik hastalıkların tedavisinde yaygın olarak kullanılan bevacizumabın kolestatik karaciğer dokusu üzerindeki etkileri tam olarak bilinmemektedir. Bu çalışmada, deneysel kolestatik karaciğer hasarı oluşturulan sıçanlarda bevacizumabın karaciğer üzerine etkilerinin değerlendirilmesi amaçlanmıştır. Çalışmada 32 adet Sprague Dawley erkek sıçan Sham, Kontrol Safra Kanalı Ligasyonu, Kontrol Bevacizumab ve Safra Kanalı Ligasyonu+Bevacizumab olmak üzere dört gruba ayrıldı. Kolestatik karaciğer hasarı ana safra kanalı ligasyonu ile oluşturuldu. Bevacizumab, ilgili gruplara operasyonun 14. gününde 5 mg/kg dozunda intraperitoneal olarak uygulandı. Dördüncü haftanın sonunda kan ve karaciğer doku örnekleri alınarak biyokimyasal, immünolojik ve histopatolojik incelemeler yapıldı. Safra kanalı ligasyonu uygulanan grupta karaciğer hasarı, inflamasyon ve fibrozis göstergelerinde belirgin bozulma saptandı. Bevacizumab uygulanan grupta TNF-α, TGF-β1 ve α-SMA düzeylerinde anlamlı düzelme gözlenirken; inflamasyon, fibrozis, duktal proliferasyon, venöz konjesyon ve büyük nükleus oluşumunda histopatolojik iyileşmeler tespit edildi. AST, ALP, GGT, total bilirubin ve direkt bilirubin düzeylerinde tedavi lehine düzelme eğilimi izlenmesine rağmen istatistiksel anlamlılık gösterilemedi. VEGF, IL-6 ve IL-10 düzeylerinde de anlamlı farklılık saptanmadı. Sonuç olarak bevacizumab, deneysel kolestatik karaciğer hasarı modelinde karaciğer dokusunda ek hasar oluşturmamış ve inflamasyon ile fibrozis ilişkili parametrelerde olumlu etkiler göstermiştir. Bu bulgular, bevacizumabın kolestatik karaciğer hasarı bulunan karaciğer dokusunda güvenle kullanılabileceğini düşündürmekte olup, sonuçların desteklenmesi için daha geniş kapsamlı deneysel ve klinik çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır. Anahtar Kelimeler: Bevacizumab, karaciğer metastazı, kolestaz, karaciğer fibrozisi

makaleler.baslik: Lymph node-targeted, mKRAS-specific amphiphile vaccine in pancreatic cancer: the randomized phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Kanserinde mKRAS Hedefli Aşı: Faz 2 AMPLIFY-7P Çalışması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Evre I-III KRAS mutasyonlu PDAC hastalarında camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) aşısının değerlendirildiği 144 hastalık faz 2 RCT'de, birincil DFS sonlanım noktasına ulaşılamadı (ortanca 23,8'e karşı 21,2 ay; HR 0,85, P=0,5329). Ancak önceden belirlenmiş analizlerde 6. ayda %14,0'lık sayısal bir DFS avantajı ve multivaryant analizlerde camupepimut lehine iyileşme görüldü (düzenlenmiş HR 0,47, P=0,0086). Güvenlik profili gözlem grubuyla benzerdi.
makaleler.ozet: Camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) drives mutated KRAS (mKRAS)-specific T cell responses that correlated with disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) in patients with mKRAS pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the phase 1 AMPLIFY-201 trial. In the phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial, patients with stage I-III KRAS-mutated PDAC without recurrence within 6 months of standard therapy were randomized 2:1 to camupepimut (n = 96) or standard-of-care/observation (n = 48). Stratification balanced nodal status. The primary DFS endpoint was not met (median 23.8 versus 21.2 months; HR 0.85, P = 0.5329). However, prespecified and exploratory analyses were informative. A numerical DFS advantage at 6 months of 14.0% (75.7% versus 61.7%; HR 0.55, P = 0.0557) corresponded to camupepimut dosing. Post hoc multivariate Cox regression analysis of DFS indicated an improved outcome for camupepimut (adjusted HR 0.47, P = 0.0086), a worse outcome for stage III disease (adjusted HR 2.29, P = 0.0127), an elevated baseline CA19-9 (adjusted HR 3.16, P < 0.0001) and baseline circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) positivity (adjusted HR 5.99, P < 0.0001). Prespecified subgroup analyses addressing prognostic and predictive factors suggested DFS benefit for camupepimut (ctDNA negative: HR 0.51, P = 0.0280; no prior radiation: HR 0.59, P = 0.0221). Exploratory analysis demonstrated that ex vivo mKRAS-specific T cell responses were robust (98.9%, 89/90) and associated with antigen spreading (86.7%, 13/15). In camupepimut-treated patients, mKRAS-specific T cell response >9.17-fold over baseline (82.2%, 74/90) correlated with improved DFS (HR 0.22, P < 0.0001), with the median DFS not reached versus 6.08 months for above and below 9.17-fold, respectively. Camupepimut safety was similar to observation, with grade ≥3 adverse events in 10.4% (10/96) versus 14.6% (7/48), and few serious AEs (6.3%, 6/96 versus 8.3%, 4/48; reflecting progression/surgical complication). These efficacy and immunogenicity signals will inform a refined strategy for a confirmatory phase 3 trial. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05726864 .

makaleler.baslik: Association Between Preoperative Steroid Use and Short-Term Outcomes Following Pancreaticoduodenectomy: A Nationwide Analysis Using the National Clinical Database.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Panikreatikoduodenektomi Sonrası Preoperatif Steroid Kullanımı ve Kısa Dönem Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Ulusal veritabanından 40.878 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, PD öncesi kronik steroid kullanımının POPF (%30,7'ye karşı %22,1) ve şiddetli komplikasyonlar (%7,7'ye karşı %4,4) ile anlamlı şekilde ilişkili olduğu gösterildi (Model 3 için POPF OR 1,80, şiddetli komplikasyonlar OR 1,71). Preoperatif steroid kullanımı enfeksiyöz komplikasyonlar ve mortaliteyi de artırdı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) carries a high risk of postoperative complications. Although steroids are widely prescribed for various chronic diseases, the specific impact after PD remains unclear. This study evaluated the association between preoperative chronic steroid use and short-term outcomes following PD.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used Japanese National Clinical Database data from 2019 to 2022. Patients undergoing PD were categorized by preoperative chronic steroid use. To account for varying background factors, three multivariable regression models with different adjustment levels (Models 1-3) were constructed.
RESULTS: Of 40 878 patients, 521 (1.3%) had chronic steroid use prior to PD. The steroid group had higher crude rates of adverse outcomes, including postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF; 30.7% vs. 22.1%) and severe complications (7.7% vs. 4.4%). In the most extensively adjusted multivariable model (Model 3), preoperative steroid use remained a significant factor associated with POPF (odds ratio [OR] 1.80, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.47-2.20) and severe complications (OR 1.71, 95% CI: 1.22-2.40). The adverse impacts on infectious complications and surgery-related mortality were also consistently significant across all models, whereas preoperative steroid use was not significantly associated with re-operation in any of the models.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative chronic steroid use is significantly associated with poor short-term outcomes after PD, including POPF, severe complications, infectious complications, and mortality. These risks remained consistent regardless of adjustment level, highlighting the need for intensive perioperative management.

makaleler.baslik: Venous Thromboembolism in Acute Necrotizing Pancreatitis Is Associated With Worse Outcomes, With Subtype-Specific Patterns: A Nationwide Analysis, 2016-2022.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Akut Nekrotizan Pankreatitte Venöz Tromboemboli Alt Tipleri ve Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: ANP tanılı 110.225 hastanın incelendiği ulusal analizde, VTE görülme sıklığı %12,25 olarak saptandı ve VTE varlığı hastane içi mortaliteyi artırdı (aOR 1,89, P<0,001). DVT (aOR 2,39) ve PVT (aOR 1,45) daha yüksek mortaliteyle ilişkilendirilirken, PVT en güçlü şekilde mezenterik iskemi ile (aOR 8,28) ve gastrik varisler SVT ile (aOR 11,37) ilişki gösterdi.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVES: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) complicates acute necrotizing pancreatitis (ANP), but outcomes across extra-splanchnic deep vein thrombosis (DVT), portal vein thrombosis (PVT), and splenic vein thrombosis (SVT) remain poorly defined. We evaluated national trends and in-hospital outcomes in ANP with versus without VTE and across VTE subtypes.
METHODS: Using the National Inpatient Sample (2016-2022), adults hospitalized with principal ANP were identified. Secondary diagnosis codes captured VTE subtypes. Primary analyses compared mortality and major complications in ANP with versus without VTE; secondary analyses compared outcomes by subtype.
RESULTS: Among 110,225 ANP hospitalizations, 12.25% had VTE. ANP with VTE had higher in-hospital mortality (aOR 1.89, P<0.001), longer length of stay (adjusted mean difference 10.7 d, P<0.001), and higher hospitalization charges (adjusted mean difference $151,685, P<0.001). VTE was associated with higher rates of mesenteric ischemia, gastric varices, upper GI bleeding, AKI, sepsis, shock, respiratory failure, ARDS, vasopressor use, mechanical ventilation, blood transfusion, and ICU admissions. On subtype analysis, DVT (aOR 2.39, P<0.001) and PVT (aOR 1.45, P=0.001) were associated with higher mortality; SVT was not significantly associated with mortality, though the analysis was limited by few events. PVT was most strongly associated with mesenteric ischemia (aOR 8.28, P<0.001), whereas gastric varices were most associated with SVT (aOR 11.37, P<0.001) and PVT (aOR 3.73, P<0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: VTE in ANP was associated with higher in-hospital mortality, systemic complications, and resource utilization, with substantial heterogeneity across subtypes. DVT-associated ANP showed higher rates of systemic complications, whereas PVT and SVT showed distinct territory-specific vascular-complication patterns. Prospective studies should evaluate phenotype-specific anticoagulation strategies.

makaleler.baslik: Risk assessment of multi-focal side-branch IPMNs: Long-term follow-up of one thousand patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Çok Odaklı Yan Dal IPMN'lerinde Uzun Dönem Takip ve Risk Değerlendirmesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Ameliyatsız takip edilen 1.000 SB-IPMN hastasının incelendiği çalışmada, 370 hastada (%37) multifokal hastalık saptandı. Multifokal ve soliter SB-IPMN hastaları arasında klinik olarak anlamlı ilerleme oranları benzer bulundu (%9,7'ye karşı %9,4, p=0,849); yüksek riskli patoloji oranı sırasıyla %3,2 ve %4,8 idi (p=0,248). Çok odaklılık hasta düzeyinde malignite riskini artırmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: While the natural history of solitary side-branch intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (SB-IPMNs) is increasingly well-described, the prevalence, disease course, and oncologic risk of multifocal disease remain poorly defined. It is unknown whether the presence of multiple cysts confers additional oncologic risk compared to solitary lesions. Our objective was to evaluate the natural history and oncologic risk associated with multifocal SB-IPMNs compared with solitary SB-IPMNs during long-term surveillance.
METHODS: Patients with side-branch intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (SB-IPMNs) undergoing non-operative surveillance with ≥2 cross-sectional imaging studies ≥6 months apart were included. The number of cysts at diagnosis and at most recent surveillance was recorded by an abdominal radiologist who was blinded to pathologic outcomes. The primary endpoint was high-risk pathology (high-grade dysplasia or invasive carcinoma). Secondary endpoints included clinically relevant (CR) progression, defined as development of guideline-based worrisome features or high-risk stigmata excluding cyst size and growth, development of new cysts, and need for surgical resection.
RESULTS: Of 1,000 patients, 370 (37%) had multifocal disease. Median follow-up was 6.6 years (IQR 3.0-10.3). Rates of CR-progression (developing worrisome features/high-risk stigmata) were similar between multifocal and solitary SB-IPMN patients (9.7% vs 9.4%, p = 0.849). High-risk pathology occurred in 43 patients (4.3%): 3.2% multifocal vs 4.8% solitary (p = 0.248). On multivariable analysis, multifocality was not associated with high-risk pathology, while CR-progression strongly predicted malignant potential (HR 31.3, 95% CI 16.3-62.1). Findings were unchanged in sensitivity analyses restricted to patients with MRI and using guideline-based progression criteria including cyst size and growth.
CONCLUSION: Multiplicity of SB-IPMNs does not confer increased malignant risk at the patient level, despite nearly 40% of patients presenting with more than one cyst. These findings support a pancreas-wide susceptibility process (described as a "field defect") rather than a focal cyst-driven phenomenon. Accordingly, each cyst should be evaluated independently according to its own risk features.

makaleler.baslik: Comparative Outcomes of Total Pancreatectomy with Islet Autotransplantation in Genetically Associated Versus Non-Genetically Characterised Chronic Pancreatitis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Genetik İlişkili ve İlişkisiz Kronik Pankreatitte TPIAT Sonuçlarının Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: TPIAT uygulanan 83 kronik pankreatitli hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, genetik ilişkili CP hastalarının ameliyatta daha genç olduğu (ortanca 30'a karşı 43 yaş; p=0,014), operasyon sürelerinin daha uzun olduğu (657'ye karşı 480 dakika; p=0,018) ve islet veriminin önemli ölçüde düşük olduğu (48.070'e karşı 149.073 IEQ; p=0,015) saptandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation (TPIAT) is an established treatment for refractory chronic pancreatitis (CP). Genetically associated CP presents earlier, progresses over longer durations, and carries an increased risk of pancreatic cancer, potentially influencing operative complexity, islet preservation, and metabolic outcomes. This study compared perioperative and long-term outcomes between genetically associated and non-genetically characterised CP patients undergoing TPIAT at a specialist UK centre.
METHODS: A retrospective review was conducted of all TPIAT procedures performed between 1994 and 2025. Patients were classified as having genetically associated (n=15) or non-genetically characterised CP (n=68) based on clinical assessment and genetic testing. Demographic, operative, postoperative, and islet isolation outcomes were compared using Mann-Whitney U and Fisher's exact tests.
RESULTS: Eighty-three patients were included. Patients with genetically associated CP were younger at surgery (median 30 vs. 43 years; p=0.014) and underwent longer operations (657 vs. 480minutes; p=0.018). Islet yield was significantly lower in genetically associated CP (48,070 vs. 149,073 IEQ; p=0.015). No major postoperative complications (Clavien-Dindo grade III-V) occurred in the genetically associated cohort. Insulin independence was lower at follow-up (12% vs. 21%; p=0.724), while opioid cessation at one year was comparable between groups (53% vs. 60%; p=0.808).
CONCLUSION: Genetically associated CP was associated with substantially lower islet yield and reduced long-term metabolic resilience despite broadly comparable pain-related outcomes following TPIAT. These findings support earlier genetic assessment and multidisciplinary referral to optimise timing of intervention and preserve long-term endocrine function.

tez.baslik: Pankreatik adenokarsinom diferansiasyon derecesinin lenf nodu metastazına etkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Pankreatik Adenokarsinomda Diferansiasyonun Lenf Nodu Metastazına Etkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Rezektabl pankreas kanseri nedeniyle cerrahi uygulanan 233 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, G1, G2 ve G3 tümörlerde LNM oranları sırasıyla %26,9, %57,4 ve %84,6 saptandı (p<0,001). G3 tümörlerde G1'e kıyasla LNM riski 14,93 kat artmış bulundu (p<0,001).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmada rezektabl pankreas kanseri nedeniyle cerrahi uygulanan hastalarda tümör diferansiasyon derecesi ile Lenf Nodu Metastazı (LNM) arasındaki ilişkinin ortaya konması ve bu ilişkinin neoadjuvan tedavi kararına olan klinik yansımalarının değerlendirilmesi amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: 2018-2024 yılları arasında genel cerrahi kliniğinde rezektabl pankreas ve periampüller bölge kanseri nedeniyle cerrahi uygulanan 233 hasta retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi. Tümör diferansiasyon derecesi AJCC TNM 8. edisyon sistemine göre G1 (iyi), G2 (orta) ve G3 (kötü) olarak sınıflandırıldı. LNM ile klinikopatolojik parametreler arasındaki ilişki istatiksel olarak analiz edildi. Bulgular: G1, G2 ve G3 gruplarda LNM oranları sırasıyla %26,9, %57,4 ve %84,6 olarak saptandı (p<0,001). G1'e kıyasla G3 tümörlerde LNM riski 14,93 kat artmış bulundu (p<0,001). LVİ (p<0,001), PNİ (p=0,002), tümör çapı (p=0,003) ve cerrahi sınır pozitifliği (p=0,012) de LNM ile anlamlı ilişki gösterdi. Multivariate analizlere göre de kötü diferansiye tümör ve LVİ pozitifliği LNM açısından birer risk faktörü olarak bulundu. Sonuç: Tümör diferansiasyon derecesi pankreas kanserinde LNM'yi öngörmede kullanılabilecek güçlü bir biyolojik belirteçtir. Özellikle G3 histolojiye sahip rezektabl pankreas kanserli hastalarda, görüntülemede lenf nodu durumu belirsiz olsa dahi neoadjuvan tedavi uygulanması için güçlü bir biyolojik gerekçe mevcuttur.

makaleler.baslik: Efficacy of indocyanine green (ICG) angiography in reducing postoperative complications in oesophagectomy: systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Özofajektomide ICG Anjiyografisinin Anastomotik Kaçak Üzerine Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2845 hastayı içeren 23 çalışmalık meta-analizde, ICG kullanımı anastomotik kaçak oranlarını anlamlı şekilde düşürmüştür (OR 0,44; %95 CI 0,29-0,65; p < 0,001). Ayrıca konduit nekrozu da ICG grubunda azalmıştır (OR 0,32; %95 CI 0,12-0,85; p = 0,022). Kanıt kesinliği gözlemsel tasarım nedeniyle düşüktür.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leakage after oesophagectomy is common, and associated with significant morbidity and mortality. Indocyanine green (ICG) fluorescence angiography has emerged as a promising intraoperative adjunct for perfusion assessment at the anastomotic site. This study aims to assess the impact of ICG use on anastomotic leakage rates and postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic search of Medline, PubMed, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library was performed. The primary outcome was anastomotic leakage. Key secondary outcomes were conduit necrosis, mortality, and reoperation; all secondary outcomes were reported. The Risk Of Bias In Non-randomized Studies - of Interventions (ROBINS-I) and Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tools were used for investigating risk of bias. Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) was used to assess certainty of evidence. A random-effects meta-analysis and meta-regression as well as subgroup and sensitivity analyses were performed.
RESULTS: From 902 identified studies, 23 met the inclusion criteria (including 4 RCTs; 2845 patients, of whom 1154 underwent ICG assessment). ICG use was associated with reduced anastomotic leakage rates (OR 0.44 (95% c.i. 0.29 to 0.65), P < 0.001; number needed to treat = 13) and conduit necrosis rates (OR 0.32 (95% c.i. 0.12 to 0.85), P = 0.022). Mortality (OR 1.43 (95% c.i. 0.69 to 2.97), P = 0.335), reoperation (OR 0.84 (95% c.i. 0.51 to 1.39), P = 0.500), severe anastomotic leakage, overall morbidity, readmission, operating time, and length of stay did not differ between groups. Certainty of evidence was low or very low across all outcomes (GRADE), predominantly driven by the observational study design of many of the studies.
CONCLUSION: Use of ICG appears to be associated with reduced anastomotic leak in oesophagectomy, although certainty of evidence is low. Assessment remains qualitative and operator-dependent.

makaleler.baslik: Management of cT2N0M0 esophageal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: cT2N0M0 Özofagus Kanserinde Tedavi Yaklaşımları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 14566 hastayı içeren 18 çalışmalık meta-analizde, neoadjuvan tedavi artı cerrahi ile primer cerrahi rezeksiyon arasında 5 yıllık genel sağkalım açısından istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark bulunmamıştır (RR 1,08; %95 CI 0,85-1,36). Perioperatif komplikasyon oranları da benzermiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Management of cT2N0M0 esophageal cancer is challenging due to staging limitations and limited evidence. While neoadjuvant therapies benefit advanced disease, its role in cT2N0M0 remains unclear, compounded by underrepresentation in trials and the differing responses to treatment between adenocarcinoma (EAC) and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). To address this, the ISDE conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis comparing outcomes of neoadjuvant therapy plus surgery (NeoAdj+S) versus primary surgical resection (PSR). MEDLINE, EMBASE, and CENTRAL were searched to 25 November 2024 for English-language studies of adults (≥18 years) with EAC or SCC staged as cT2N0M0. Case series with ≤7 patients, recurrent disease were excluded. Two independent reviewers (YE, SL) selected studies, and extracted data. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to assess outcomes. Of 299 unique articles screened, 18 studies were included, totaling 14,566 cT2N0 patients. Pooled analysis revealed no statistically significant differences between NeoAdj+S and PSR in terms of 5-year overall survival (OS) (RR 1.08, 95% CI 0.85-1.36; favoring NeoAdj+S), 3-year OS (RR 1.10, 95% CI 0.92-1.30; favoring NeoAdj+S); 5-year disease-free survival (RR 0.88, 95% CI 0.70-1.12; favoring PSR), 30-day mortality (RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.53-1.54; favoring NeoAdj+S), overall complication rates (RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.87-1.08; favoring NeoAdj+S); surgical complications (RR 0.92, 95% CI 0.78-1.08; favoring NeoAdj+S); or medical complications (RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.61-1.23; favoring NeoAdj+S). All included studies demonstrated high risk-of-bias. No clear survival or perioperative advantage was found for NeoAdj+S over PSR. High-quality clinical trials are needed to guide treatment decisions.

makaleler.baslik: Active surveillance versus standard surgery after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy for oesophageal cancer: long-term results of a cluster-randomised controlled trial (SANO).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Özofagus Kanserinde Aktif İzlem ve Standart Cerrahi Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 309 hastanın dahil olduğu çok merkezli RCT'nin uzun vadeli sonuçlarında, 5 yıllık genel sağkalım aktif izlem ve standart cerrahi arasında farklı bulunmamıştır (%50'ye karşı %54; HR 1,17; %95 CI 0,77-1,77). Aktif izlem grubunda uzak metastaz kümülatif insidansı daha yüksek saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The Surgery As Needed for Oesophageal cancer (SANO)-trial demonstrated that active surveillance is non-inferior to standard surgery in terms of two-year overall survival in patients with a complete clinical response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT). Active surveillance resulted in improved quality of life. Here, we report five-year outcomes.
METHODS: From 2017 to 2021, a multicentre stepped-wedge cluster-randomised non-inferiority trial was conducted. Patients with locally advanced oesophageal cancer who achieved complete clinical response (defined as no tumour detected on endoscopic biopsies, -ultrasound, or PET-CT) underwent active surveillance or standard surgery. Cox regression was used to compare five-year overall and disease-free survival, and the cumulative incidence of distant metastases was estimated using competing risk analysis.
RESULTS: A total of 309 patients were included, 198 underwent active surveillance and 111 underwent standard surgery. Median follow-up was 76 months (IQR 67-86). Five-year overall survival was not statistically significantly different between active surveillance and standard surgery (50%, 95%CI 43-57 vs. 54%, 95%CI 46-64; HR 1.17, 95%CI 0.77-1.77) with similar results across histologic subtypes. Disease-free survival was not statistically significantly different (HR 1.39, 95% CI 0.94-2.06). The cumulative incidence of distant metastases at five years was significantly higher in the active surveillance group compared to the standard surgery group (46%, 95%CI 39-53 vs. 29%, 95%CI 21-37; P<.01). Overall, 85 of 198 patients (43%) avoided oesophagectomy, including those with sustained complete clinical response at last follow-up or distant metastases detected within six months after nCRT.
CONCLUSIONS: Overall survival at five years is not statistically significantly different between active surveillance and standard surgery in patients with oesophageal cancer and a complete clinical response after nCRT, despite a higher incidence of distant metastases in the active surveillance group. These findings support active surveillance as a feasible treatment strategy in selected patients.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology

makaleler.baslik: Tranexamic acid in laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy: bleeding control amid thrombotic concerns and hemodynamic instability: a randomized double-blinded clinical trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomide Traneksamik Asit Kullanımı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 185 morbid obez hastayla yapılan randomize çift kör klinik çalışmada, traneksamik asit intraoperatif kanama sıklığını anlamlı düzeyde azaltmış (%1'e karşı %5,5; p = 0,012) ve postoperatif hemoglobin düzeylerini yükseltmiştir (12,5 g/dL'ye karşı 11,1 g/dL; p = 0,002). Tromboembolik olay gözlenmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG) carries a risk of intraoperative and postoperative bleeding. Tranexamic acid (TXA) has been proposed to reduce blood loss. We evaluated the efficacy of TXA in preventing perioperative bleeding in patients undergoing LSG.
METHODS: In a randomized clinical trial, 185 morbidly obese patients scheduled for elective LSG were randomly assigned to receive TXA (n = 93) or a placebo (n = 92) before surgery. The rate of bleeding requiring blood transfusion, 24-hour serum hemoglobin levels, postoperative hemodynamic indices, and the incidence of postoperative thrombotic events were assessed.
RESULTS: Intraoperative bleeding occurred less frequently in the TXA group than in the placebo group (1 versus 5.5%, p = 0.012). Postoperative hemoglobin levels were higher in the TXA group (12.5 ± 1.2 g/dL versus 11.1 ± 1.5 g/dL, p = 0.002), while transfusion requirements, hemodynamic stability, and length of hospital stay were similar between groups. No postoperative thromboembolic events were observed. Multivariable analysis confirmed TXA as an independent predictor of reduced bleeding and higher postoperative hemoglobin levels.
CONCLUSION: TXA significantly reduced intraoperative bleeding and improved postoperative hemoglobin levels in LSG without increasing hemodynamic instability or the risk of thromboembolic events.

makaleler.baslik: Neoadjuvant Therapy for Gastric Adenocarcinoma with Signet Ring Cells: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mühür Yüzük Hücreli Gastrik Adenokarsinomda Neoadjuvan Tedavi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 5388 hastayı kapsayan meta-analizde, mühür yüzük hücreli mide kanserinde neoadjuvan kemoterapinin primer cerrahiye kıyasla genel sağkalımda anlamlı bir iyileşme sağlamadığı gösterilmiştir (HR 0,96; %95 CI 0,68-1,34). Sonuçlar hem Batı hem Doğu çalışmalarında tutarlı bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Signet ring cell-containing gastric cancer constitutes an increasingly recognized subtype. Although perioperative chemotherapy is the standard of treatment for locally advanced gastric cancer, its efficacy in signet ring cell-containing gastric adenocarcinomas remains controversial. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to assess the impact of neoadjuvant chemotherapy compared to upfront surgery on overall survival.
METHODS: A systematic search of MEDLINE, Scopus, and Cochrane was conducted up to January 2026. Eligible studies included adult patients with signet ring cell-containing gastric cancer undergoing neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by surgery compared to upfront gastrectomy. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to pool hazard ratios for overall survival.
RESULTS: Six studies, including seven cohorts and 5.388 patients, were included. The pooled analysis demonstrated no significant difference in overall survival between neoadjuvant chemotherapy and upfront surgery (HR 0.96, 95% CI 0.68-1.34, I2 = 83.2%). Subgroup analyses by studies' geographic origin and design revealed consistent results with no significant differences in overall survival among Western (HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.53-1.38, I² = 86.9%) or Eastern studies (HR 1.12, 95% CI 0.63-1.97, I² = 83%), and among different study designs (randomized controlled trial: HR 1.16, 95% CI 0.81-1.67; observational: HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.62-1.38, I² = 85.5%).
CONCLUSIONS: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy was not associated with a significant improvement in overall survival compared with upfront surgery in signet-ring cell-containing gastric cancer. While perioperative chemotherapy remains the recommended therapeutic approach, further studies employing contemporary chemotherapy regimens are warranted to define its role in this distinct histological subtype.

tez.baslik: Mide kanseri hastalarında neoadjuvan kemoterapinin postoperatif sonuçlar ve sağkalım üzerine etkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Kemoterapinin Postoperatif Sonuçlara Etkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Mide kanseri nedeniyle küratif gastrektomi yapılan 236 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, neoadjuvan kemoterapinin majör postoperatif komplikasyonları artırmadığı gösterilmiştir. NAK grubunda genel sağkalım açısından anlamlı fark görülmezken (HR=1,03; p=0,892), rekürrenssiz sağkalımın daha düşük olduğu saptanmıştır (HR=2,32; p=0,003).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Mide kanseri, dünya genelinde önemli bir küresel sağlık sorunu olmaya devam etmektedir. Cerrahi rezeksiyon küratif tedavinin temel taşı olmakla birlikte, özellikle lokal ileri hastalıkta tek başına cerrahi ile sağkalım oranları istenilen seviyeye ulaşamamıştır. Neoadjuvan kemoterapi (NAK) umut verici bir strateji olarak ortaya çıkmıştır. Bu çalışmanın amacı, mide kanseri nedeniyle küratif amaçlı tedavi uygulanan hastalarda neoadjuvan kemoterapinin postoperatif sonuçlar, morbidite ve uzun dönem sağkalım üzerindeki etkilerini araştırmaktır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Karadeniz Teknik Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Ana Bilim Dalı'nda Mayıs 2015 ile Ekim 2025 tarihleri arasında küratif amaçlı gastrektomi uygulanan hastalar retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi. Hastalar, cerrahi öncesi neoadjuvan kemoterapi alanlar (NAK grubu) ve doğrudan cerrahi uygulananlar (Cerrahi grubu) olmak üzere iki gruba ayrılmıştır. Primer sonlanım noktası majör postoperatif komplikasyonlar, ikincil sonlanım noktaları ise rezeksiyon sınırları, genel sağkalım ve rekürrenssiz sağkalım olarak belirlenmiştir. Hastalara ait klinik, patolojik ve takip verileri Üst GİS bölümü veritabanından ve hastane kayıt sisteminden elde edilmiştir. İstatistiksel değerlendirmede; postoperatif komplikasyonların analiz edilmesi ve risk faktörlerinin belirlenmesi amacıyla tek ve çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon modelleri kullanılmıştır. Uzun dönem onkolojik sonuçların değerlendirilmesi için yapılan sağkalım analizlerinde, sağkalım eğrilerinin oluşturulması için Kaplan-Meier yöntemi kullanılmış ve gruplar arası farklar log-rank testi ile karşılaştırılmıştır. Ayrıca, genel sağkalım ve hastalıksız/rekürrenssiz sağkalım ile ilişkili bağımsız prognostik faktörlerin belirlenmesinde tek değişkenli ve çok değişkenli Cox orantısal hazard regresyon analizleri uygulanmıştır. Bulgular: Analize toplam 236 hasta dahil edilmiş olup, 83 hastaya (%35,2) NAK uygulanırken 153 hastaya (%64,8) doğrudan cerrahi uygulanmıştır. NAK uygulanan hastalarda, cerrahi grubuna kıyasla gastrektomi sonrası majör postoperatif komplikasyonlar, yeniden operasyon ihtiyacı, hastanede yatış süresi ve mortalite oranları açısından istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir farklılık saptanmamıştır. Onkolojik sonuçların analizinde, NAK uygulamasının genel sağkalım ile bağımsız bir ilişkisinin bulunmadığı görülmüştür (Çok değişkenli analiz: HR=1,03; %95 GA: 0,65–1,65; p=0,892). Diğer yandan, küratif rezeksiyon uygulanan hastalar değerlendirildiğinde NAK grubunda rekürrenssiz sağkalımın daha düşük olduğu ve NAK uygulanmasının daha yüksek rekürrens riski ile ilişkili bulunduğu saptanmıştır (HR=2,32; %95 GA: 1,33–4,05; p=0,003). Bu durumun, çalışmanın retrospektif doğası gereği oluşan seçim yanlılığı ve NAK uygulanan hasta grubunun tedavi başlangıcında daha ileri klinik evreye ve daha yüksek tümör yüküne sahip olmasından kaynaklanması olasıdır. Sonuçlar: Gerçek yaşam verilerine dayanan bu çalışma, uygun hasta seçimi yapıldığında neoadjuvan kemoterapi sonrası gastrektominin, majör postoperatif komplikasyonları artırmadan ve erken cerrahi güvenlikten ödün vermeden uygulanabileceğini göstermiştir. Genel sağkalım üzerine istatistiksel anlamlı etkisi görülmemiştir. Rekürrenssiz sağkalım konusunda görülen dezavantajın seçim yanlılığı ile ilişkili olması muhtemeldir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Mide kanseri, Gastrektomi, Neoadjuvan tedavi, Komplikasyon, Genel Sağkalım, Hastalıksız sağkalım.

makaleler.baslik: Preoperative educational interventions in bariatric surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahide Preoperatif Eğitim Programları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13 RCT'yi içeren bu meta-analizde, preop eğitim programlarının standart bakıma kıyasla preop BMI'da anlamlı azalma ve 30 günlük postop komplikasyonlarda mutlak düşüş sağladığı gösterilmiştir. Egzersiz temelli girişimler fonksiyonel kapasiteyi artırırken, diyet ve davranışsal programların etkileri değişken bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet: Preoperative educational interventions in bariatric surgery are structured programs combining information, skills training, and behavioral support delivered before metabolic and bariatric surgery and are increasingly incorporated into surgical pathways. However, these interventions vary substantially in content, intensity, and mode of delivery, and their efficacy on clinically meaningful outcomes remains uncertain. Therefore, this study aimed to systematically evaluate the effects of preoperative educational interventions on weight-related, functional, metabolic, and surgical outcomes in patients undergoing bariatric surgery. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. Randomized controlled trials evaluating structured preoperative educational interventions were included. Meta-analyses using random-effects models were performed where appropriate. Outcomes unsuitable for quantitative pooling were synthesized narratively. Risk of bias was assessed using Risk of Bias 2, and intervention reporting was evaluated using the Template for Intervention Description and Replication checklist. Thirteen randomized controlled trials were included. A meta-analysis showed that preoperative educational interventions were associated with a clinically meaningful reduction in preoperative body mass index compared with standard care. However, this pooled estimate was highly heterogeneous, driven primarily by a single very-low-calorie-diet trial. A significant absolute reduction in 30-day postoperative complications was also observed. Exercise-based interventions improved functional capacity, as measured by the 6-minute walk test, although heterogeneity was substantial. Dietary interventions did not consistently improve postoperative anthropometric outcomes, whereas cognitive-behavioral interventions primarily influenced behavioral rather than weight outcomes. Eating behavior measures demonstrated consistent directional improvements, whereas evidence on metabolic outcomes was limited and fragmented. Because such interventions are already embedded in many state-of-the-art bariatric programs, the priority is not broad adoption but standardization of intervention content, identification of the specific components that drive clinically meaningful benefit, and evaluation of longer-term outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Dual benefit of esketamine-based opioid-free anesthesia on postoperative pain and mental health outcomes in patients undergoing bariatric surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahide Esketamin Temelli Opioid-Free Anestezi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Laparoskopik sleeve gastrektomi yapılan 84 hastanın alındığı çift kör RCT'de, esketamin grubu hastalarında ilk 24 saatte postop ağrı şiddeti anlamlı derecede düşük bulunmuş ve orta-şiddetli ağrı insidansı azalmıştır (P<0,05). 3 ay sonraki ruh sağlığı skorları da esketamin grubunda anlamlı düzeyde daha iyi saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet: Patients with morbid obesity are at a high risk of comorbid depressive and anxiety symptoms. While bariatric surgery is an effective treatment, conventional opioid-based anesthesia carries significant perioperative risks. Opioid-free anesthesia (OFA) presents a safer alternative. Esketamine, known for its dual analgesic and rapid antidepressant effects, is a promising component of OFA. However, clinical evidence supporting its simultaneous benefits for both physical and psychological recovery in bariatric patients remains limited. In this double-blind, randomized clinical trial, patients scheduled for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either esketamine-based anaesthesia or opioid-based anaesthesia with remifentanil during surgery. The co-primary outcomes were postoperative pain intensity within the first 24 h and mental health status at three months after surgery. Secondary outcomes included pharmacokinetics of esketamine and adverse events. A total of 84 patients were randomized, with 42 allocated to each group. Seventy-four participants (88.1%) completed the 3-month follow-up. Patients in the esketamine group experienced significantly lower postoperative pain intensity (P < 0.01) and a reduced incidence of moderate-to-severe pain (P < 0.05) within 24 h after surgery. Mental health outcomes at 3 months were also significantly better in the esketamine group, and adverse events rate did not differ significantly. Pharmacokinetic analysis showed that plasma esketamine concentrations increased rapidly during infusion, with early formation of the active metabolite (S)-norketamine. Compared to opioid-based anaesthesia, esketamine-based opioid-free anaesthesia was associated with improved postoperative analgesia and better mental health outcomes in morbidly obese patients undergoing bariatric surgery, without increasing adverse events.

makaleler.baslik: Evaluating the role of metabolic surgery versus GLP1 agonists in patients living with obesity and chronic kidney disease - a systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Metabolik Cerrahi ve GLP-1 Agonistlerinin Renal Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2487 hastanın verilerini içeren bu sistemik derlemede, metabolik cerrahinin GLP-1 agonistlerine kıyasla CKD progresyonunu (%21,7'ye karşı %45,1; P=0,006) ve böbrek yetmezliği gelişimini (%24,0'e karşı %43,8; P=0,048) anlamlı ölçüde azalttığı gösterilmiştir. Ayrıca metabolik cerrahi mikroalbüminüri ve CKD remisyon oranlarını da anlamlı şekilde artırmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic surgery and glucagon-like petide-1 receptor agonists (GLP1) have renoprotective effects. Unlike GLP1 agonists, metabolic surgery is not endorsed as a therapeutic strategy for patients living with obesity, concurrent type-II diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
AIMS: To perform a systematic review to evaluate the renal outcomes of metabolic surgery and GLP1 agonists in patients living with obesity, T2DM and CKD.
METHODS: A systemic review was performed as per PRISMA guidelines. Basic descriptive statistics were performed using SPSS v26.0.
RESULTS: Overall, 6 studies met eligibility criteria, including three retrospective studies, two Markov Model analyses, and one randomized clinical trial. Data from 2487 patients were included [metabolic surgery: 48.7% (1210/2487) vs GLP1 agonists: 51.3% (1277/2487)]. Relative to GLP1 agonists, metabolic surgery significantly reduced CKD progression [21.7% (40/183) vs. 45.1% (109/242),P = 0.006] and renal failure development [24.0% (44/183) vs. 43.8% (106/242),P = 0.048], while also increasing microalbuminura remission [82.4% (42/51) vs. 46.9% (23/49), P < 0.001] and CKD remission [82.4% (42/51) vs. 55.1% (27/49),P < 0.001]. Metabolic surgery also significantly increased patient eligibility for transplantation [19.7% (192/976) vs. 2.1% (22/986),P < 0.001]. Two recent Markov analyses were performed to simulate the impact of metabolic surgery and GLP1 use in increasing patient eligibility for transplantation; 14.7% and 4.8% of simulated patients undergoing sleeve gastrectomy and GLP1 therapy would successfully undergo renal transplant at 5-years respectively.
CONCLUSION: Compared to GLP1 agonists, metabolic surgery seemingly serve in reducing the risk of CKD progression and renal failure development in patients living with obesity, T2DM and CKD, while also increasing patient eligibility for transplant.
