makaleler.baslik: Hemobezoar-related jejunojejunostomy obstruction after minimally invasive Roux-en-Y gastric bypass: a systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: RYGB Sonrası Hemobezoara Bağlı Jejunojejunostomi Obstrüksiyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 7669 minimal invaziv RYGB prosedürü ve 29 obstrüksiyon olgusunun incelendiği sistemik derlemede, hamilebezoara bağlı jejunojejunostomi obstrüksiyon insidansı %0,38 olarak saptanmıştır. Olgular genellikle ilk 72 saatte obstrüksiyon bulguları ile başvurmuş olup, erken BT tanısı, remnant dekompresyonu ve minimal invaziv pıhtı tahliyesi ile başarılı sonuçlar bildirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Hemobezoar-related jejunojejunostomy (JJ) obstruction is a rare early complication after minimally invasive Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB). Although early small bowel obstruction after RYGB is well described, obstruction caused by hemobezoar formation remains poorly characterized.
METHODS: This systematic review followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines and was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261320591). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL were searched from inception through February 2026. Eligible studies reported adults undergoing primary minimally invasive RYGB with early hemobezoar-related JJ obstruction. Data were extracted on study characteristics, presentation, diagnostic modality, operative strategy, gastric decompression, and outcomes. Given its rarity and lack of comparative cohorts, findings were summarized descriptively.
RESULTS: Six studies met inclusion criteria, including 7669 minimally invasive RYGB procedures and 29 hemobezoar-related JJ obstructions. The crude incidence was 0.38%, with per-study incidence ranging from 0.09% to 1.94%. Presentation was consistently early, most commonly within 72 postoperative hours, frequently included tachycardia, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, hematocrit decline, and gastrointestinal bleeding. Computed tomography with intravenous contrast was the predominant diagnostic modality, demonstrating dilation of the excluded stomach and proximal limbs with hyperdense intraluminal content at the JJ. Operative management evolved from laparotomy with JJ revision in earlier reports to laparoscopic clot evacuation with selective revision when anastomotic compromise, leak, ischemia, or ongoing bleeding was identified. Gastric remnant decompression was emphasized to reduce closed-loop distension and intraperitoneal contamination. No deaths were reported among 29 cases, although morbidity included abscess formation, anastomotic or staple-line complications, pancreatitis, respiratory complications, readmission, and repeat reoperation.
CONCLUSION: Hemobezoar-related JJ obstruction after minimally invasive RYGB is uncommon but important. It typically presents within the first postoperative days with obstructive symptoms and evidence of intraluminal bleeding. Across retrospective studies, favorable outcomes were reported following prompt CT diagnosis, early operative exploration, remnant decompression, and minimally invasive clot evacuation with selective anastomotic revision. Prospective validation of this management approach is needed.

makaleler.baslik: Metabolic bariatric surgery versus GLP-1 receptor agonists in dialysis patients with diabetes and obesity: a target trial emulation study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: ESKD Hastalarında Metabolik Bariatrik Cerrahi ve GLP-1RA Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Tip 2 diyabet ve obezitesi olan ESKD hastalarında, MBS ve GLP-1RA tedavileri değerlendirildi. MBS, eşleştirilmiş GLP-1RA grubuna kıyasla daha yüksek kısa vadeli mortalite ile ilişkilendirildi (1 yıllık aHR 2,68).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are effective treatments for obesity and type 2 diabetes, but their comparative survival and waitlisting benefits in end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) remain unclear.
OBJECTIVES: To compare survival and kidney transplant (KT) waitlisting after MBS and GLP-1RA use among patients with ESKD, using dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP-4is) as an active comparator.
SETTING: US Renal Data System, 2010-2022.
METHODS: We included adults with ESKD, type 2 diabetes, and ≥class II obesity treated with MBS, GLP-1RA, or DPP-4i. Three target trials were emulated: MBS versus GLP-1RA (N = 1818), MBS versus DPP-4i (N = 2111), and GLP-1RA versus DPP-4i (N = 4338). Cox models estimated adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for all-cause mortality and KT waitlisting over 1-5 years.
RESULTS: MBS recipients were younger at dialysis initiation than matched GLP-1RA and DPP-4i users. MBS was associated with higher short-term mortality than matched GLP-1RA (1-year aHR = 2.68, 95% confidence interval [CI]:1.98-3.63; 3-year aHR = 1.34, 95% CI: 1.09-1.64) and DPP-4i users (1-year aHR = 1.74, 95% CI: 1.35-2.25), but comparable longer-term mortality. GLP-1RA users had consistently lower mortality than matched DPP-4i users. MBS was associated with higher KT waitlisting than GLP-1RA and DPP-4i use, with no differences between GLP-1RA and DPP-4i users.
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with ESKD, type 2 diabetes, and obesity, MBS was associated with higher short-term but comparable long-term mortality, whereas GLP-1RA use was associated with lower mortality than DPP-4i use. MBS was also associated with higher KT waitlisting than GLP-1RA and DPP-4i use, suggesting distinct risk-benefit profiles of metabolic treatment in this high-risk population.

tez.baslik: Morbid obezite nedeniyle bariatrik cerrahi yapılan hastalarda fatty acid binding protein düzeylerinin ameliyat öncesi ve sonrası karşılaştırılması: Bariatrik cerrahinin başarısının değerlendirilmesinde yeni yöntem
tez.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Fatty Acid Binding Protein Düzeyleri
tez.kisa_ozet: Morbid obezite nedeniyle bariatrik cerrahi yapılan 62 hastayı içeren uzmanlık tezinde, LSG başarısı %83,7 ve RYGB başarısı %94,7 bulundu. FABP analizlerinde ameliyat sonrasında anlamlı bir değişim izlenmedi.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı morbid obezite nedeniyle 2 farklı tip bariatrik cerrahi prosedür uygulanan hastalarda ameliyat sonrası dönemde çeşitli FABP izomerlerinin ameliyat sonrası hasta başarısı ile ilişkisinin saptanmasıdır. Bu veriler obez hastaların ameliyat sonrası dönemde değerlendirilmesini sağlayacaktır. Materyal ve metot: Merkezimizde morbid obezite nedeni ile bariatrik cerrahi (gastrik bypass ya da sleeve gastrektomi) yapılan 18.65 yaş arasındaki 62 hasta dahil edilmiştir. Hastaların elektronik dosyalarından preop ve postop rutin kan sonuçlarına ulaşılmıştır. Preop ve postop 3, 6, ve 9. aylardaki antropometrik ölçümleri ve yaklaşık 4 ml kan örnekleri rutin biyokimya tüpüne alınmıştır. Örnekler santrifüj edilerek serum elde edilmiştir. Serumlar, AFABP, EFABP, LFABP, HFABP, IFABP çalışılmak amacıyla enzim bağlantılı immunosorbent analizi (ELİSA) yöntemi kullanılarak analiza edilmiştir. Bulgular: Çalışmamıza toplam 62 morbid obez birey dahil edilmiştir. Hasta grubumuzun 43'ü (%69,4) Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomi (LSG) ve 19'u (%30,6) Roux.en.Y Gastrik Bypass (RYGB) prosedürü uygulanan hastalardan oluşmaktadır. LSG grubunda başarı oranı %83,7, RYGB grubunda başarı oranı %94,7 ve tüm cerrahi prosedürlerde toplam başarı oranı %87,1 olarak bulunmuştur. Şuanki literatür araştırmamız, FABP' lerin işlevleri ve görevleri, yapılan gen delesyonlu fare deneyleri gösteriyorki; bariatrik cerrahi sonrası kontrollerde FABP düzeylerinde genel bir düşüş izlenmesi muhtemeldir. Ancak yaptığımız çalışmada ne LSG grubunda ne de RYGB grubunda FABP analizlerinde anlamlı bir değişim izlenmemiştir. Sonuç: Daha ileri çalışmalarla bulgularımızın obezite üzerine çalışan araştırmacı ve klinisyenlere yeni bir bakış açısı kazandıracağını ve FABP' lerin obezitenin önemli bir göstergesi olarak bariatrik cerrahi yöntemlerinin biyobelirteci olarak kullanılabileceğini umuyoruz. Anahtar Kelimeler: Morbid obezite, Bariatrik cerrahi, Yağ asidi bağlayıcı protein

makaleler.baslik: Hypofractionated Versus Conventionally Fractionated Postmastectomy Radiotherapy With Internal Mammary Node Irradiation for High-Risk Breast Cancer (HypoMast-IMNI): A Randomized Phase III Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanseri ve Radyoterapi: HypoMast-IMNI Faz III Çalışması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Yüksek riskli operabl meme kanserinde 1.494 hastayla yapılan faz III RCT'de, 16 fraksiyonda hipofraksiyone radyoterapi (HypoRT), locoregional kontrol açısından konvansiyonel radyoterapiye (ConvRT) noninferior bulundu (5 yıllık LRR %1,7'ye karşı %2,2; HR 0,69; p=0,017). HypoRT'de grade 3 akut cilt toksisitesi anlamlı derecede düşüktü (%1,7'ye karşı %12,2; p<0,001).
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: When coverage of internal mammary nodes (IMN) is required, the efficacy and safety of hypofractionated regimens within postmastectomy radiotherapy (PMRT) remain to be established. This study evaluated hypofractionated radiotherapy (HypoRT) in patients with high-risk, operable breast cancer undergoing PMRT with IMN irradiation (IMNI).
METHODS: In this phase III noninferiority trial, eligible patients with high-risk disease after mastectomy (including pT1-4N2-3, pT3-4N1, or pT1-2N1 disease with additional high-risk factors) were randomly assigned (1:1) to HypoRT (42.56 Gy in 16 fractions) or conventionally fractionated radiotherapy (ConvRT; 50 Gy in 25 fractions), both targeting the chest wall and regional lymph nodes, including the IMN. The primary end point was locoregional recurrence (LRR). Secondary end points were distant metastasis-free survival (DMFS), breast cancer recurrence-free survival (BCRFS), disease-free survival (DFS), overall survival (OS), and treatment-related toxicity. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrial.gov (identifier: NCT03856372).
RESULTS: Between September 2018 and July 2022, 1,494 patients were randomly assigned. After a median follow-up of 58.1 months in the modified intention-to-treat population (n = 1,429), the 5-year cumulative incidence of LRR was 1.7% (95% CI, 0.9 to 2.9) with HypoRT and 2.2% (95% CI, 1.3 to 3.5) with ConvRT (hazard ratio, 0.69 [95% CI, 0.32 to 1.51]), meeting the noninferiority criterion (P = .017). No significant differences were observed in 5-year DMFS, BCRFS, DFS, or OS. Grade 3 acute skin toxicity was significantly lower with HypoRT (1.7% v 12.2%, P < .001). The incidence of grade ≥2 radiation pneumonitis and pulmonary fibrosis was low and comparable between arms, with no ischemic cardiac events recorded.
CONCLUSION: For patients with high-risk, operable breast cancer requiring PMRT with IMNI, the 16-fraction HypoRT regimen is noninferior to ConvRT for locoregional control, offers a superior acute toxicity profile, and demonstrates excellent cardiopulmonary safety.

makaleler.baslik: An International Randomized Prospective Trial Comparing a Supine MRI-based Guidance System, The Breast Cancer LocatorTM, to Wire Localization for Breast-Conserving Surgery for Non-palpable Breast Cancer.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Koruyucu Cerrahide MR Tabanlı Kılavuz Sistemi ile Tel İşaretleme Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Palbe edilemeyen meme kanserli 418 hastada yapılan RCT'de, Breast Cancer Locator (BCL) tel lokalizasyonu ile karşılaştırıldı. Pozitif cerrahi sınır oranı (PMR) BCL grubunda %14,4, tel grubunda %21,1 olarak bulundu (fark -%7,1; p=0,011 ile noninferiorite gösterildi). BCL grubunda re-eksizyon oranı %12,9'a karşı %19,6 oldu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Positive margins after breast-conserving surgery (BCS) require additional surgery, a negative patient experience that also adds costs to care. Pilot trials indicate the Breast Cancer LocatorTM (BCL), a novel supine magnetic resonance imaging-based guidance system, helps surgeons resect cancers with a low positive margin rate (PMR). Our objective was to evaluate BCL noninferiority and superiority compared with wire localization (WL) in reducing the PMR with BCS.
METHODS: Patients with nonpalpable, magnetic resonance imaging-visualized invasive breast cancer or ductal carcinoma in situ undergoing BCS were prospectively randomized to either BCL or WL.
RESULTS: In total, 418 randomized patients underwent surgery. The PMR was 14.4% (30/209) in the BCL group and 21.1% (44/209) in the WL group, a relative decrease of 32%. In primary analysis, the treatment difference was -7.1% (95.4% confidence interval [CI] -14.3 to 0.1). Noninferiority was demonstrated (p = 0.011). The one-sided p-value for superiority (p = 0.025) slightly exceeded the prespecified significance level of 0.023. In prespecified analysis stratified by final tumor type, the PMR was significantly lower in the BCL group (p = 0.019). Fewer BCL patients underwent re-excision: 12.9% versus 19.6%, a relative decrease of 34%. The PMR for all tumor types was lower in the BCL group, with a > 60% relative reduction in PMR in patients with ductal carcinoma in situ (20.6% vs. 53.3% [95% CI -52.1 to -9.1]) and invasive lobular carcinoma (9.1% vs. 25.6% [95% CI -32.9 to -0.2]). Adverse event rates were similar.
CONCLUSIONS: BCL was noninferior to WL and superior in analysis stratified by final tumor type. Clinically meaningful relative reductions in PMR and re-excision rates were observed.

makaleler.baslik: Bilateral Ultrasound-Guided Erector Spinae Plane Block versus Serratus Anterior Plane Block for Postoperative Analgesia in Breast Reduction Surgery: A Prospective, Randomized, Outcome Assessor- Blinded, Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Küçültme Cerrahisinde ESPB ve SAPB Bloklarının Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Bilateral meme küçültme ameliyatı geçiren 70 kadın hastada yapılan RCT'de erektör spina plan bloğu (ESPB) ile serratus anterior plan bloğu (SAPB) karşılaştırıldı. 24 saatlik ortalama tramadol tüketimi SAPB grubunda 70,0 mg iken ESPB grubunda 53,2 mg bulundu (p=0,043).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Breast reduction surgery is a common aesthetic procedure associated with significant postoperative pain. Effective analgesia plays an important role in reducing opioid consumption, minimizing adverse effects, facilitating postoperative recovery, and improving patient satisfaction. Fascial plane blocks have recently gained popularity for breast surgery. This randomized study aimed to compare the effects of bilateral erector spinae plane block (ESPB) and serratus anterior plane block (SAPB) on postoperative analgesia in patients undergoing breast reduction surgery.
METHODS: Seventy female patients undergoing bilateral breast reduction surgery were randomly allocated into two groups: ESPB (Group ESPB, n = 35) and SAPB (Group SAPB, n = 35). Blocks were performed bilaterally under ultrasound guidance, with 20 mL of 0.25% bupivacaine each side, 30 min before surgery. All procedures were performed using the wise-pattern reduction mammoplasty technique with a superiomedial pedicle by the same surgical team. Postoperative analgesia included intravenous paracetamol, ibuprofen, and intravenous tramadol patient-controlled analgesia (PCA). Primer outcome was 24-h tramadol consumption through intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (PCA). Secondary outcomes included time to first analgesic requirement from PCA, postoperative pain scores (NRS), intraoperative remifentanil consumption, perioperative variables, length of hospital stay, and adverse effects.
RESULTS: Primary-outcome data were available for 35 SAPB and 34 ESPB patients. Mean 24-hour tramadol consumption was 70.0 ± 37.7 mg with SAPB and 53.2 ± 29.1 mg with ESPB (mean difference, SAPB minus ESPB, 16.8 mg; 95% confidence interval, 0.5-33.0 mg; p = 0.043). Median time to first analgesic requirement was 420 min with SAPB and 630 min with ESPB (log-rank p < 0.001). Pain scores did not differ significantly. Nausea occurred in five SAPB patients and no ESPB patients (Fisher's exact p = 0.054); vomiting occurred in either group. Bradycardia occurred in one ESPB group patient (p = 1).
CONCLUSIONS: In this single-center trial, ESPB was associated with lower 24-h tramadol consumption and a longer time to first PCA demand than SAPB, while pain scores were comparable.

makaleler.baslik: Artificial Intelligence in Breast Cancer Diagnosis, Treatment, and Perioperative Management: A Systematic Review of Current Applications and Future Perspectives.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde Yapay Zekâ Uygulamaları: Sistematik Derleme
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Meme kanseri tanısı ve tedavisinde yapay zekâ uygulamalarını inceleyen 17 birincil çalışmanın sistematik derlemesinde, mamografi taramalarında derin öğrenme AUC değerlerine 0,876 ile 0,939 arasında ulaştı. 80.033 kadında yapılan randomize çalışmada radyolog iş yükünde %44,3 azalma sağlandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Breast cancer is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy in women globally, accounting for approximately 2.30 million new cases and 666,103 deaths in 2022. Artificial intelligence technologies including machine learning, deep learning, radiomics, and natural language processing have been widely applied across the breast cancer care continuum. However, no systematic review restricted to primary studies with patient-level or image-level data has synthesized evidence spanning all clinical domains simultaneously.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the performance, methodological quality, and clinical relevance of artificial intelligence primary studies across screening and diagnostic imaging, digital pathology, radiomics, perioperative management, prognostic prediction, and natural language processing in breast cancer.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from January 2015 to May 2026. Eligibility was restricted to original primary research reporting patient-level or image-level data; secondary syntheses were explicitly excluded. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-2 and PROBAST. Reporting followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines.
RESULTS: Of 5,275 identified records, 17 primary studies met eligibility criteria. In screening mammography (seven studies; n = 7,540 to 144,231 examinations), deep learning achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.876 to 0.939; a randomised trial in 80,033 women demonstrated non-inferiority to double reading with a 44.3% reduction in radiologist workload. In digital pathology (five studies; 270 to 44,732 whole-slide images), deep learning achieved AUC 0.985 to 0.994, exceeding unassisted pathologist performance in lymph node metastasis detection. Magnetic resonance imaging radiomics predicted pathological complete response in HER2-positive breast cancer with AUC 0.80. No breast cancer-specific perioperative primary study met the eligibility criteria. Deep survival networks achieved concordance index 0.626 versus 0.612 for Cox regression in breast cancer cohorts. Natural language processing identified metastatic recurrence in breast cancer clinical records with sensitivity 83% and specificity 73%. Risk of bias was low to moderate for imaging and pathology studies and high for small sample radiomics studies. Density-stratified performance was reported by only two imaging studies, and receptor status prediction from haematoxylin and eosin staining had not been validated as a safe alternative to immunohistochemistry.
CONCLUSIONS: Artificial intelligence demonstrated clinically meaningful performance across the five domains with eligible primary studies. Breast cancer-specific perioperative and intensive care primary studies were absent, representing the largest evidence gap. External validation, demographic diversity, and prospective clinical integration evidence remained the most consistently identified limitations. Prediction of molecular receptor status without immunohistochemistry requires rigorous prospective safety validation before it can complement standard testing.

makaleler.baslik: Single-Stage Nipple Sparing Mastectomy with Concurrent Mastopexy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Eş Zamanlı Mastopeksi ile Tek Seferlik NSM: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1.076 memeyi içeren 19 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, eş zamanlı NSM ve mastopeksi sonrasında parsiyel NAC nekrozu %5,9, total NAC nekrozu %0,9 ve mastektomi flep nekrozu %3,1 bulunmuştur. Seçilmiş hasta popülasyonlarında bu yaklaşımın güvenli olduğu gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Patients with macromastia or breast ptosis are typically considered poor candidates for nipple-sparing mastectomy (NSM) due to concerns regarding nipple and mastectomy flap vascularity as well as challenges in maintaining optimal nipple position due to the redundant skin envelope. Several techniques for concurrent NSM and mastopexy have been described with encouraging results; however, data is limited to case series with small sample sizes. PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane databases were queried to identify all studies analyzing outcomes in patients who underwent nipple-sparing mastectomy and simultaneous mastopexy with implant-based reconstruction. Study characteristics, patient demographics, surgical techniques, and post-operative complications were collected from relevant articles. Random-effects model meta-analysis was performed to assess complication rates. Nineteen studies, with a pooled total of 1,076 breasts were identified for analysis. The average patient was 48.1 ± 5.2 years old with a mean BMI of 27.2 ± 3.0 and a mean mastectomy specimen weight of 701.3 ± 93.8 g. The majority of mastopexies were performed using a Wise-pattern skin resection (70%) however there was a wide variety of dermal pedicles used to supply the nipple-areolar complex (NAC). Meta-analysis demonstrated acceptable complication rates, including partial NAC necrosis (5.9%, CI 3.0-9.5 %), total NAC necrosis (0.9%, CI 0.0-2.4%), and mastectomy flap necrosis (3.1%, CI 0.7-6.6%). The current literature supports the safety of performing single-stage NSM and mastopexy in favorable and highly selective patient populations. Additional studies are needed to refine specific, objective preoperative and intraoperative indications as well as to evaluate aesthetic and patient-reported outcomes.

tez.baslik: Meme kanserli hastalarda serum OX40 VE OX40L düzeyine etki eden kritik gen varyantlarının incelenmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde OX40 ve OX40L Gen Varyantlarının Rolü
tez.kisa_ozet: 84 meme kanseri hasta ve 118 sağlıklı gönüllü ile yapılan çalışmada, OX40 rs17568 G alleli (OR 2,31; p<0,001) ve GG genotipinin hastalık riskiyle ilişkili olduğu saptanmıştır. Serum sOX40 düzeylerinin hasta grubunda anlamlı derecede yüksek olduğu bildirilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Meme kanseri dünyada ve Türkiye'de en sık rastlanan kanser türlerinden biri olup 2050 yılına kadar vaka sayılarında ciddi artış beklenmektedir. Tedaviye dirençli vakaların varlığı, yeni tanı ve tedavi stratejilerini zorunlu kılmaktadır. Bu noktada immünoterapi, hastanın bağışıklık sistemini kullanarak kanser hücrelerini hedef alan umut verici bir yöntem olarak öne çıkmaktadır. Özellikle T hücresi aktivasyonunda ve bağışıklık yanıtının sürdürülmesinde kritik rol oynayan OX40 ve ligandı OX40L, immünoterapötik açıdan büyük potansiyel taşımaktadır. OX40 agonistleri üzerine yürütülen klinik çalışmalar ve genetik varyasyonların moleküler etkileri, meme kanserinin erken teşhisi ve tedavi başarısının artırılması konusunda umut vaat etmektedir. Biz de meme kanseri hastalarında sOX40 ve sOX40L düzeyleri ile genetik varyantların, hastalığın klinik ve patolojik seyri üzerindeki etkisini ve aralarındaki ilişkiyi incelemeyi hedefledik. Çalışmada hasta grubu, neoadjuvan tedavi almamış 84 kadın meme kanseri hastasından; kontrol grubu ise kanser öyküsü veya şüphesi bulunmayan 118 sağlıklı gönüllü kadından oluşturulmuştur. OX40 rs17568 ve OX40L rs1234313 genetik varyantları, Restriksiyon Parça Uzunluk Polimorfizm (RFLP) tekniği kullanılarak analiz edilmiştir. Alınan örneklerdeki serum sOX40 ve sOX40L düzeyleri, ELISA yöntemi ile ölçülmüştür. Hasta ve kontrol gruplarının yaş ortalamaları açısından istatistiksel olarak benzer olduğu saptanırken (p=0,056), ailede meme kanseri öyküsü varlığının hasta grubunda anlamlı derecede yüksek olduğu görülmüştür (p=0,045). Hardy-Weinberg dengesiyle uyumlu olan OX40 rs17568 polimorfizminde G alleli (OR=2,31; p<0,001) ve GG (OR=2,78; p=0,001) genotipin hastalık riskiyle güçlü ilişkisi saptanmıştır. OX40L rs1234313 polimorfizminde ise A allelinin (OR=1,80; p=0,004) ve AA genotipinin (OR=4,6; p<0,001) risk artışı ile ilişkili olduğu görülmüştür Serum düzeylerinde serum sOX40 düzeylerinin hasta grubunda anlamlı derecede yüksek olduğu izlenirken (p=0,009), serum sOX40L düzeylerinde gruplar arasında benzer bir fark saptanmamıştır (p=0,09). Bulgularımız OX40/OX40L yolağının meme kanseri etyopatogenezi ve klinik seyrinde hem genetik hem de sistemik düzeyde kritik bir rol oynadığını ortaya koymaktadır. OX40 rs17568 polimorfizmine ait G alleli ve GG genotipinin yanı sıra, serum sOX40 düzeylerindeki artışın meme kanseri riskiyle ilişkili bulunması; OX40L rs1234313 polimorfizmindeki A alleli ve AA genotipinin de benzer bir risk artışına işaret etmesi, bu yolağın meme kanserinde potansiyel bir biyobelirteç ve kişiselleştirilmiş tedavi stratejileri için stratejik bir hedef olabileceğini göstermektedir.

makaleler.baslik: Small-bite compared with large-bite closure of midline laparotomy: meta-analysis of short- and long-term outcomes with trial sequential analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Midline Laparotomi Kapatılmasında Small-Bite ve Large-Bite Tekniklerinin Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2617 hastayı içeren 10 RCT'nin incelendiği bu meta-analizde, small-bite tekniği insizyonel hernia riskini %43 oranında azaltmıştır (RR 0.57; p=0.003). Ayrıca small-bite tekniği surgical-site infection ve total komplikasyon oranlarını da düşürmüştür.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Fascial closure after a midline laparotomy (ML) is a crucial step to avoid incisional hernia. This meta-analysis aimed to compare short- and long-term outcomes, including incisional hernia, of the small-bite versus large-bite closure techniques in ML.
METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of RCTs comparing small-bite (5-mm bites/spacing) and large-bite (10-mm bites/spacing) techniques in ML closure was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central were searched from inception through April 2026 for eligible RCTs. The primary outcome was incisional hernia. Secondary outcomes included total complications, surgical-site infection (SSI), seroma, fascial dehiscence, closure time, and pain. Pairwise meta-analyses and trial sequential analyses (TSA) were performed.
RESULTS: Ten unique RCTs reported in 12 publications (2617 patients) were included. Among the five studies using standardized clinical and imaging assessment, small-bite closure reduced incisional hernia by 43% (risk ratio (RR) of 0.57 (95% c.i. 0.39 to 0.82) (P = 0.003, I2 = 44.1%), compared with an RR of 0.31 (95% c.i. 0.18 to 0.53) (P < 0.001, I2 = 0) when clinical assessment only was used). Across all eligible studies with follow-up >12 months, the pooled RR was 0.48 (95% c.i. 0.33 to 0.70). This benefit persisted on the analysis of studies with ≥24 months of follow-up (RR 0.56 (95% c.i. 0.36 to 0.89)). TSA demonstrated firm evidence for benefit despite not reaching the required information size. Small-bite closure was also associated with reduced SSI (RR 0.72) and total complications (RR 0.76), with no differences in seroma or fascial dehiscence. Closure time was slightly longer with small-bite closure (weighted mean difference 4.82 min), while pain scores were comparable.
CONCLUSION: The small-bite technique significantly reduced incisional hernia and postoperative complications after ML, with durable benefit extending beyond 2 years.

makaleler.baslik: Prophylactic neurectomy versus nerve preservation in open inguinal hernia repair for prevention of chronic postoperative inguinal pain (CPIP): a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kasık Fıtığı Onarımında Proflaktik Neurektomi ile Sinir Korumanın Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 17 randomize çalışmanın dahil edildiği meta-analizde, proflaktik neurektomi kronik postoperative inguinal pain oranını azaltmıştır (%9,3'e karşı %18,1; RR 0,37; %95 CI 0,25-0,55). Ancak neurektomi sensory loss artışı ile ilişkilendirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Chronic postoperative inguinal pain remains an important source of disability after open inguinal hernia repair. The review evaluated whether planned prophylactic neurectomy reduces chronic pain compared with nerve preservation in adults undergoing elective open anterior repair.
METHODS: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Ovid MEDLINE were searched from January 2000 through March 2026. Randomized controlled trials comparing intentional neurectomy of one or more inguinal nerves with preservation during open anterior repair were eligible. Two reviewers independently selected studies, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using RoB 2. Random-effects models pooled risk ratios and standardized mean differences.
RESULTS: Seventeen randomized trials were included. At the longest follow-up, chronic postoperative inguinal pain occurred in 166 of 1779 participants after neurectomy and 294 of 1627 after preservation (9.3% vs. 18.1%; RR, 0.37; 95% CI, 0.25-0.55; I² = 69.2%). Associations favored neurectomy at 3, 6, and 12 months or longer. Moderate-to-severe chronic pain remained statistically uncertain. Sensory loss or change increased, while groin numbness remained similar. Acute pain and rescue analgesic use were lower. Health-related quality of life, recurrence, and surgical complications did not differ meaningfully.
CONCLUSION: Prophylactic neurectomy was associated with less chronic pain but more sensory disturbance and no measurable quality-of-life benefit. Incomplete reporting of nerve identification in control procedures, methodological limitations, and heterogeneity preclude routine use. Existing trials could not identify patients most likely to benefit.

makaleler.baslik: Systematic review and meta-analysis of mesh versus suture repairs of small umbilical hernias (≤ 2 cm).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Küçük Umblikal Hernilerde Mesh ve Sütür Onarımlarının Sistemik İncelemesi ve Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Küçük umblikal herni onarımlarını inceleyen meta-analizde, mesh kullanımı postoperatif recurrence oranlarını anlamlı şekilde düşürmüştür (RR 0.46; p<0.00001). Sütür onarımları ise haematoma/bleeding ve infection riskinde üstün bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Updated guidelines of approaches to small umbilical hernia repairs (UHRs) ≤ 2 cm defect size are inconclusive. Operations to resolve small UHRs remain high heterogeneous depending upon local guidelines and surgical expertise, therefore there is no clear optimal approach nor guideline. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to evaluate mesh versus suture methodological approaches in small UHR.
METHODS: Systematic search of four databases (EMBASE, PubMed, OVID, MEDLINE) retrieved relevant studies after screening, de-duplication, eligibility assessment and full-text analyses were conducted. Descriptive and numerical analysis was achieved for each included study in line with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. Risk of bias assessment was achieved using Cochrane risk of bias methodologies (Risk of bias in non-randomised studies, ROBINS-I; Risk of bias tool, RoB-2). Primary outcome assessed was recurrence; secondary outcomes included haematoma, bleeding, infection, systemic complications and patient-reported pain scores.
RESULTS: Mesh approaches to UHRs resulted in fewer recurrence rates postoperatively in variable follow-up periods (RR 0.46 (95% CI 0.38-0.55, I2 = 0%, p < 0.00001). Limited intra-group meta-analysis of mesh techniques demonstrated improved recurrence rates associated with onlay mesh compared with inlay/plug, intraperitoneal and sublay approaches (p = 0.00162). Suture approaches were superior for haematoma/ bleeding (RR 1.74 95% CI 1.16-2.75, I2 = 0%, p = 0.0009); infection risk (RR 1.75, 95% CI 1.18-2.59, I2 = 0%, p = 0.007); however, did not reach statistical significance for pain scores postoperatively (RR = 1.20, 95% CI 0.98-1.47, I2 = 0%, p = 0.07).
CONCLUSION: Mesh-based small UHRs offers superior outcomes for short and long-term recurrence rates, although increased risk of bleeding and infection. Subgroup analyses of mesh repairs revealed merit for onlay approaches for recurrence although analysis is limited by heterogeneous study design. No significant difference in recurrence risk with choice of suture material was found. Symptomatic burden and quality-of-life detriments were not significantly higher in mesh group therefore authors contend for greater adoption of mesh-based approaches in small UHRs. Further RCTs specifically investigating small UHRs are encouraged to establish long-term adverse consequences, and longitudinal patient-reported outcome measures.

makaleler.baslik: Fascial Dehiscence Despite Declared Adoption of European Hernia society guidelines: A retrospective study following laparotomy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparotomi Sonrası Fasial Dehiscence ve Kılavuz Uyumu: Retrospektif Çalışma
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Laparotomi sonrası fasial dehiscence gelişen 81 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, vakaların %74,1'i acil cerrahi olup, %67,9'unda small-bite tekniği belgelenmiştir. Medyan dehiscence süresi 7 gün ve 90 günlük mortalite %12,3 olarak bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Abdominal fascial dehiscence is a serious postoperative complication following laparotomy, associated with high morbidity and mortality. Although the small-bite technique is recommended by the European Hernia Society, its implementation in clinical practice, particularly in emergency surgery, remains uncertain. This study described documented fascial closure practices among patients with fascial dehiscence following laparotomy and characterised patient-related and technical features within this cohort.
METHODS: This retrospective study included all patients who developed fascial dehiscence following laparotomy at two surgical departments in the North Denmark Region between 1 March 2021 and 1 March 2026. Data on demographics, comorbidities, operative characteristics, closure technique, and postoperative outcomes were collected from medical records and analysed using descriptive statistics.
RESULTS: A total of 81 patients were included. Most underwent acute laparotomy (74.1%), and 66.7% were classified as ASA score ≥ III. The declared small-bite technique was documented in 67.9% of cases, while conventional large-bite suturing was not recorded in any patient. Suture-to-wound length ratio was documented in only 2 patients (2.5%), both achieving a ratio of 4:1. Median time to dehiscence was 7 days (IQR 4-10), and reoperation was performed in 97.5% of patients. Management strategies at reoperation varied considerably, most commonly VAC therapy (46.9%) and small-bite re-suturing (43.2%), while conventional large-bite repair, absent at primary closure, was used in 6.2% of cases. The Clavien-Dindo distribution was bimodal (40.7% Grade I, 40.7% Grade IIIb), and 90-day mortality was 12.3%.
CONCLUSION: The declared small-bite technique was the predominant documented closure method among patients who developed fascial dehiscence. The high prevalence of emergency surgery and comorbidity in this cohort may suggest that patient-related and physiological factors contribute substantially to this complication. Near-universal absence of suture-to-wound length ratio documentation precludes firm conclusions regarding true guideline compliance, while marked heterogeneity in reoperative closure reflects a lack of evidence-based guidance. Improving documentation standards and directing future research toward high risk, emergency populations represent key priorities.

makaleler.baslik: Repair of elective epigastric hernias in adults: nationwide registry study of short- and long-term complications requiring reoperation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Erişkinlerde Elektif Epigastrik Herni Onarımı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1112 hastanın incelendiği ulusal retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, 4,77 yıllık takip sonucunda mesh onarımının herni nüksü nedeniyle reoperasyon riskini dikiş onarımına göre azalttığı saptandı (HR 0,28; p=0,007). Buna karşılık mesh onarımı, nüks dışı komplikasyon riskini artırdı (5,27 oranında, p=0,029). Açık sublay veya açık IPOM en elverişli profili gösterirken, açık onlay ve lap-IPOM nüks dışı komplikasyonlarla ilişkilendirildi.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: To define the role of different mesh positions in elective epigastric hernia repair (EHR) for fascial defects < 10 cm.
METHODS: A retrospective nationwide Danish cohort of adult patients undergoing EHR from 2017 to 2020, ensuring complete follow-up on December 31, 2023, through nationwide registries and scrutiny of all operative notes of subsequent re-interventions. Primary outcome was reoperation for recurrence. Secondary outcomes were reoperation for non-recurrence and any complications. Multivariable analyses were performed using Cox proportional hazards regression, with Firth's penalized likelihood when applicable.
RESULTS: Among 1,112 patients included, 69.2% underwent mesh repair. Median follow-up was 4.77 years. Mesh repair had significant lower risk of reoperation for hernia recurrence than suture repair (hazard-ratio (HR) 0.28, p = 0.007). Open preperitoneal, retromuscular, or intraperitoneal (open sublay or open IPOM) and laparoscopic intraperitoneal onlay mesh (lap-IPOM) were independently associated with lower recurrence risk compared with suture repair (p < 0.001 and p = 0.006). Reoperation for non-recurrence complications was more frequent after mesh repair than after suture repair (5.27, p = 0.029). Open onlay and lap-IPOM were associated with a nearly sevenfold increased risk of non-recurrence complications (p = 0.014 and p = 0.033). Few non-recurrence complications were directly mesh-related, and severe complications were rare. Open sublay or open IPOM repair was associated with a reduced risk of reoperation for any complication (0.21, p = 0.039).
CONCLUSION: Mesh repair was associated with reduced reoperation for hernia recurrence, but increased risk of non-recurrence complications compared with suture repair, resulting in a comparable overall risk of reoperation. Open sublay or open IPOM repair demonstrated the most favorable profile, with reduced recurrence and few overall complications, whereas open onlay and lap-IPOM were associated with increased non-recurrence complications.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT06783036.

tez.baslik: Nüks inguinal herni cerrahisinde anterior ve posterior yaklaşımın etkinliği
tez.baslik_tr: Nüks İnguinal Herni Cerrahi Yaklaşımlarının Karşılaştırılması
tez.kisa_ozet: 106 hastanın incelendiği tek merkezli retrospektif tez çalışmasında, hastaların 74'ü açık ve 32'si laparoskopik olarak ameliyat edildi. Laparoskopik grupta komorbidite yükü ve ASA skorları anlamlı düzeyde daha düşük bulundu (p=0,006). Postoperatif komplikasyon oranları açık grupta %29,7, laparoskopik grupta %25,0 saptanırken, erken-geç komplikasyon, ağrı ve nüks açısından gruplar arasında anlamlı fark bulunmadı (p>0,05).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmada kliniğimizde nüks inguinal herni nedeniyle ameliyat olan hastaların demografik özellikleri, vücut kitle indeksi (VKİ), Amerikan Anestezistler Derneği (ASA) skoru, primer ameliyat tekniği ve ek hastalıkları gibi faktörlerin nüks nedeniyle yapılacak ameliyatın teknik seçimine etkisi araştırıldı. Uygulanan ameliyatın erken ve geç dönem komplikasyonlarına bakılarak tedavide en uygun cerrahi yaklaşımın belirlenmesi için literatüre veri kazandırmak amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: Ankara Etlik Şehir Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde 15.12.2022- 15.04.2025 tarihleri arasında nüks inguinal herni tanısı ile ameliyat edilen yetişkin hastalar çalışma kapsamına alındı. Tek merkezli bu çalışmada veriler tıbbi ve cerrahi kayıtların retrospektif olarak incelenmesiyle toplandı. Bu çalışma Helsinki Bildirgesi'ne uygun olarak yürütüldü. Çalışmaya Dahil etme kriterleri;  Hastanın 18 yaşından büyük olması.  Nüks inguinal herni nedeniyle elektif şartlarda ameliyat edilmesidir. Çalışmanın dışlama kriterleri;  18 yaşından küçük olan hastalar,  Acil cerrahi girişim gerektiren strangüle nüks inguinal herni hastaları,  Başka merkezde ameliyat edilen hastalar,  Nüks inguinal herni tanısı olup ameliyat edilmemiş hastalardır. Bulgular: Çalışmaya toplam 106 hasta dahil edildi, 106 hasta analiz edildi. Hastaların 74'ü (%69,8) açık, 32'si (%30,2) laparoskopik teknikle ameliyat edildi. Olguların %91,5'i erkekti. Gruplar arasında cinsiyet dağılımı, yaş (55,11 ± 13,89 vs. 55,84 ± 15,32 yıl; p = 0,809) ve VKİ (26,08 ± 3,34 vs. 26,59 ± 2,65 kg/m²; p = 0,526) açısından anlamlı fark saptanmadı. Komorbidite açısından gruplar arasında anlamlı farklılık izlendi; laparoskopik cerrahi grubunda ASA skorları anlamlı derecede daha düşük bulundu (p = 0,006). Charlson Komorbidite İndeksi (Tablo 6.) de laparoskopik grupta anlamlı olarak daha düşüktü (U = 883,5; p = 0,018). Komorbidite varlığı açık cerrahi grubunda daha yüksek oranda saptandı (%47,3 vs. %25,0; p = 0,032). Genel anestezi laparoskopik grupta anlamlı derecede daha sık tercih edildi (%96,9 vs. %58,1; p 0,05). Clavien–Dindo Sınıflaması'na (Tablo 7.) göre komplikasyon dağılımı benzer olup olguların büyük çoğunluğu evre I düzeyindeydi (p>0,05). Toplam komplikasyon oranları açık ve laparoskopik gruplarda sırasıyla %29,7 ve %25,0 olup anlamlı fark saptanmadı (p = 0,620). Birinci ve altıncı ay takiplerinde rekürrens oranları ile birinci ay ağrı ve altıncı ay kronik ağrı oranları açısından gruplar arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark bulunmadı (p>0,05). Kılavuzların önerdiği "karşı plan" yaklaşımlı cerrahi teknikler ile diğer cerrahi tekniklerin erken ve geç dönem komplikasyon oranları, rekürrens oranları, ağrı durumu ve komplikasyon şiddeti arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı ilişki saptanmadı. Ancak anatomik zorluk varlığı ile cerrahi teknik seçimi arasında anlamlı ilişki bulundu (p<0,001). Aynı anatomik plandan onarım (AAPO) tercih edilen hastalarda daha çok anatomik diseksiyon güçlüğü görüldüğü ortaya çıktı. Sonuç: Laparoskopik cerrahi uygulanan hastalarda komorbidite yükü ve ASA skorlarının daha düşük olduğu görüldü. Buna karşın postoperatif komplikasyon oranları, ağrı ve kısa–orta dönem rekürrens sonuçları açısından açık ve laparoskopik cerrahi yöntemleri arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı. Uygun hasta seçimi yapıldığında her iki cerrahi yaklaşımın da benzer güvenlik ve etkinlik profiline sahip olabileceği düşünüldü. Kılavuzların önerdiği "karşı plan" yaklaşımı (çalışmamızdaki "karşı anatomik plandan onarım (KAPO)" tanımı) uluslararası önerilerle uyumlu olmakla birlikte, çalışmamızda erken komplikasyonlar, ağrı, rekürrens ve Clavien–Dindo Sınıflaması'na göre komplikasyon şiddeti açısından alternatif tekniklere belirgin üstünlük göstermediği görüldü. Buna karşın anatomik zorluk açısından KAPO yaklaşımı uygulandığında diğer yaklaşımlara üstün olduğu görüldü. Bu durum, nüks inguinal herni cerrahisinde kılavuz temelli yaklaşımın, hastaya özgü anatomik/cerrahi faktörler doğrultusunda bireyselleştirilmesi gerektiğini desteklemektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Nüks inguinal herni, açık cerrahi, laparoskopik cerrahi, Charlson Komorbidite İndeksi, ASA skoru, postoperatif komplikasyon, rekürrens, kronik ağrı.

makaleler.baslik: Clinical Outcomes of Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease After Liver Transplantation for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Primer Sklerozan Kolanjit İçin Karaciğer Nakli Sonrası İBD Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 34 çalışmayı (3828 hasta) içeren meta-analizde, kolektomi gerektiren İBD insidans hızı 1000 kişi-yılında 12,4 bulunmuştur. PSC nüksü PSC-İBD hastalarında PSC-tek başına hastalara göre daha yüksektir (IRR 2,16; p<0,001).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The clinical course of primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC)-associated inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) after liver transplantation (LTx) varies significantly across studies. This meta-analysis aims to provide a comprehensive estimation of incidence rates (IR) for IBD-related outcomes and PSC recurrence.
METHODS: Online databases (January 2000-June 2025) were searched for studies on PSC patients with or without IBD at LTx. Studies reporting posttransplant outcomes of interest were included. The pooled IR were calculated with the "meta" package (R Studio [V.4.3.2]) using a random effects model.
RESULTS: A total of 34 studies (3828 patients; 67% with IBD at transplantation) were included. The IR of preexiting IBD exacerbation was 36.1 per 1000 person-years (95% confidence intervals [CI], 23.0-56.5). Medically refractory IBD requiring colectomy occurred at an IR of 12.4 per 1000 person-years (95% CI, 8.9-17.4). The IRs of colorectal neoplasia and advanced neoplasia were 10.3 (95% CI, 6.4-16.7) and 7.7 (95% CI, 5.6-10.7) per 1000 person-years, respectively. Among posttransplant PSC-only patients, the IR of newly diagnosed IBD was 20.0 (95% CI, 12.0-33.4). PSC recurrence occurred more frequently in PSC-IBD patients (31.9; 95% CI, 25.0-40.5) than in PSC-only patients (21.4; 95% CI, 11.3-40.6), corresponding to an incidence rate ratio of 2.16 (95% CI, 1.72-2.72; P < 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: After LTx for PSC, patients remain at substantial risk of colorectal neoplasia and de novo IBD. PSC-IBD is associated with a higher risk of disease recurrence. These findings support continued endoscopic surveillance and close monitoring of IBD activity.

makaleler.baslik: Hourglass optimization in pancreas transplantation: A systematic review (HOP study).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Transplantasyonunda Zamanlama ve İskemi Optimizasyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 12 çalışmanın incelendiği sistematik derlemede, soğuk iskemi süresinin ≥20-24 saat olmasının teknik başarısızlığı ve erken greft kaybını artırdığı, bu sürenin en önemli modifiye edilebilir risk faktörü olduğu gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pancreas transplantation provides durable metabolic control for selected patients with insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus but remains uniquely vulnerable to early technical failure. Ischemia-reperfusion injury is central to graft loss, yet the relative impact of discrete, time-dependent intervals during donor management, procurement, and implantation is incompletely defined. This systematic review evaluates how procurement-related temporal variables influence early complications and pancreas graft survival.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted in accordance with Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines and registered with PROSPERO (no. 1303859). MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Knowledge were searched from January 1996 to February 2026 for studies reporting donor-related timing variables and pancreas transplant outcomes. Primary exposure variables included brain-death-to-procurement time, donation after circulatory death agonal and asystolic times, pancreas extraction time, cold ischemia time, and vascular anastomosis time. Primary outcomes were technical graft failure and pancreas graft loss.
RESULTS: Twelve studies met inclusion criteria. Prolonged brain-death-to-procurement time was paradoxically associated with improved long-term graft survival and reduced acute rejection, suggesting potential graft stabilization following brain death. In donation after circulatory death donors, functional warm ischemia and asystolic time-but not total time to death-were independently associated with increased graft loss, demonstrating a phase-specific vulnerability once circulation ceases. Pancreas extraction time showed inconsistent associations with postoperative complications and was not an independent predictor of graft survival. In contrast, cold ischemia time emerged as the most consistent and clinically significant determinant of outcome, with a nonlinear threshold effect: cold ischemia time ≥20-24 hours markedly increased technical failure, thrombosis, and early graft loss, whereas each additional hour incrementally worsened long-term survival. Anastomosis time was not independently associated with graft outcomes.
CONCLUSION: Pancreas graft outcomes are determined by the cumulative and phase-specific burden of ischemic injury accrued from donor management through implantation. Among all temporal variables, cold ischemia time remains the dominant modifiable risk factor, while minimizing asystolic and functional warm ischemia is critical in donation after circulatory death procurement. Emerging perfusion strategies may mitigate time-dependent injury and expand the donor pool. Optimizing each procurement interval remains essential to improving early technical success and durable graft survival in pancreas transplantation.

makaleler.baslik: Randomized Clinical Trial of Ringer's Lactate Versus Chloride-Reduced Saline-Dextrose in Postoperative Kidney Transplantation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Nakli Sonrası Ringer Laktat ve Klorür Azaltılmış Salin Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 134 hastanın katıldığı RCT'de, postoperatif 4. günde Ringer Laktat grubunda serum bikarbonat düzeyi daha yüksek (19,39'a karşı 17,31 mEq/L; P<0,001) ve 1. ay eGFR daha iyi bulunmuştur (61,63'e karşı 53,18 ml/dk; P=0,028).
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Normal saline administration induces hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis, potentially impairing kidney allograft recovery. The comparative efficacy of balanced crystalloids against actively chloride-reduced saline protocols remains unclear.
METHODS: This randomized, open-label trial compared Ringer's Lactate Solution (RLS) with a dynamic dual-infusion protocol of normal saline and 5% dextrose (NSS + D5W) in adult kidney transplant recipients. Using a prespecified modified intention-to-treat analysis, 134 patients who received ≥2 L of study fluid were evaluated. Fluids were strictly titrated to hourly urine output. The primary outcome was day-4 serum bicarbonate. Secondary outcomes evaluated the overall treatment strategy, including protocolized rescue bicarbonate requirements, 1-month estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) as an indicator of early functional recovery, and exploratory mechanistic biomarkers (urine neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin [NGAL] and serum cytokines).
RESULTS: On postoperative day 4, the RLS group maintained significantly higher serum bicarbonate (19.39 vs. 17.31 mEq/L; P < 0.001) and required substantially less rescue bicarbonate therapy (17.9% vs. 58.2%; P < 0.001) compared with the NSS + D5W group. Serum chlorides were comparable between groups on day 4. RLS was associated with more favorable early allograft function, evidenced by a higher 1-month eGFR (61.63 vs. 53.18 ml/min per 1.73 m2; P = 0.028). Among the deceased-donor recipients, a lower proportion of RLS group had high urine NGAL (>100 ng/ml) and elevated interferon-γ; however, the continuous NGAL comparison was not significant and other cytokines (tumor necrosis factor [TNF]-α, interleukin [IL]-6, and IL-10) did not differ. These exploratory biomarker findings are hypothesis-generating.
CONCLUSION: RLS effectively reduces early postoperative metabolic acidosis and was associated with better short-term allograft functional recovery compared with a chloride-reduced saline regimen. These benefits are most applicable to allografts exhibiting immediate or early function that permits standard volume expansion.

makaleler.baslik: Application of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway in liver transplantation and its impact on patient self-management: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Transplantasyonunda Hemşirelik Bakım Demeti ve Klinik Yol
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 100 hastalık tek merkezli RCT'de, hemşirelik bakım demeti ve klinik yol entegrasyonu 1 ve 6. aylarda ESCA, BAASIS ve GQOLI-74 skorlarını artırmış, FBG, ALT, SCr ve TBil seviyelerini iyileştirmiştir (P<0,05).
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to explore the effects of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway on self-management ability, postoperative biochemical markers, medication adherence, psychological status, and quality of life among liver transplant recipients.
METHODS: This study was a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial. A total of 103 patients who underwent liver transplantation were initially screened. Three individuals were excluded due to severe postoperative complications (n = 1), incomplete medical records (n = 1), or inability to adhere to follow-up procedures (n = 1). The remaining 100 patients completed follow-up and were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the control group (n = 50) or the intervention group (n = 50) using a random number table. The control group received routine perioperative nursing care and standard follow-up after discharge. The intervention group received a structured nursing care bundle integrated with a clinical nursing pathway under the enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) framework. Primary outcome included self-management ability [assessed using the Chinese version of the Exercise of Self-Care Agency Scale (ESCA)]. Secondary outcomes included postoperative biochemical indicators at 1 and 6 months after discharge [including fasting blood glucose (FBG), 2-hour postprandial blood glucose (2 h-PBG), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), serum creatinine (SCr), total bilirubin (TBil), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and therapeutic drug concentrations], medication adherence [assessed by the Basel Assessment of Adherence to Immunosuppressive Medications Scale (BAASIS)], psychological status [measured by the Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS) and Self-Rating Anxiety Scale (SAS)], and quality of life (evaluated using the GQOLI-74 questionnaire).
RESULTS: At both 1 and 6 months following discharge, patients in the intervention group demonstrated better biochemical outcomes, including lower FBG, 2 h-PBG, ALT, SCr, TBil, and BUN levels, as well as more stable drug concentrations compared with the control group (P < 0.05). Furthermore, ESCA scores, BAASIS scores, and GQOLI-74 scores were all higher in the intervention group than in the control group (P < 0.05). SDS and SAS scores were reduced in the intervention group relative to the control group (P < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: The integration of a nursing care bundle with a clinical nursing pathway has a positive effect on improving self-management ability and medication adherence, optimizing postoperative biochemical indicators, alleviating negative emotions, and enhancing quality of life in liver transplant patients.

makaleler.baslik: Network Meta-Analysis of Static Cold Storage Versus Dynamic Organ Preservation for Liver Transplantation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Naklinde Statik Soğuk Saklama ve Dinamik Organ Koruma Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Karaciğer naklinde dinamik organ koruma yöntemlerini değerlendiren 13 RCT ve 1888 alıcının dahil olduğu network meta-analizde, tüm dinamik koruma yöntemlerinin statik soğuk saklamaya (SCS) kıyasla daha iyi sonuçlarla ilişkili olduğu, HMP'nin ise birincil sonuçlarda NMP'den üstünlük kurmadığı gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Donor organ scarcity and increasing use of extended-criteria donors have driven the development of dynamic preservation methods to improve outcomes following liver transplantation. Hypothermic machine perfusion (HMP) and normothermic machine perfusion (NMP), controlled oxygenated rewarming (COR), and ischemia-free liver transplantation (IFLT) are dynamic preservation methods that have been compared with traditional static cold storage (SCS). However, no randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have directly compared HMP with NMP. The aim of the present study is to conduct a network meta-analysis (NMA) of RCTs to compare the effects of available dynamic preservation strategies on clinical outcomes.
METHODS: Electronic databases were systematically searched for RCTs evaluating dynamic preservation methods in human liver transplantation. Eligibility criteria included reporting of at least one of the following primary outcome measures: early allograft dysfunction (EAD), biliary complications, and graft survival. A random-effects Bayesian NMA with a non-informative prior was conducted.
RESULTS: Thirteen RCTs were included with a total of 1888 recipients and assessed 5 interventions. IFLT had the highest probability of being the best-ranked treatment for EAD and biliary complications, but these findings were based on a single RCT. HMP (7 RCTs) ranked higher than NMP (4 RCTs) across all primary outcomes, whereas NMP ranked higher than SCS for EAD and biliary complications. Subgroup analysis of extended criteria brain-dead donors was consistent with overall findings.
CONCLUSIONS: Dynamic preservation modalities were associated with improved outcomes compared with SCS. HMP ranked higher than NMP across the primary outcomes. However, these comparisons were predominantly indirect and do not establish superiority of HMP over NMP.

tez.baslik: Expanded kriteri taşıyankadaverik renal transplant hastaları ileev diyalizi hastalarınınuzun dönem sonuçlarının karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Expanded Kriterli Kadaverik Renal Transplant ve Ev Diyalizi Hastalarının Sonuçları
tez.kisa_ozet: Expanded Kriterli Donörlerden (ECD) böbrek nakli yapılan son dönem böbrek yetmezliği hastaları ile ev diyalizi tedavisi gören hastaların uzun dönem klinik sonuçlarını karşılaştırmayı amaçlayan bu tez çalışmasında, iki modalite arasında hasta sağkalımı açısından anlamlı bir fark olmayacağı öngörülmektedir.
tez.ozet: Son dönem böbrek yetmezliği (SDBY), önemli bir halk sağlığı sorunu olup, hastalar için yüksek mortalite, morbidite ve düşük yaşam kalitesi ile karakterizedir. Böbrek transplantasyonu (KT), SDBY için ideal tedavi yöntemi olarak kabul edilmekle birlikte, kadavradan organ bağışındaki yetersizlik, bekleme listelerinin uzamasına ve Expanded Kriterli Donörlerden (ECD) elde edilen böbreklerin kullanımının artmasına yol açmıştır. Eş zamanlı olarak, ev diyalizi modaliteleri (Ev Hemodiyalizi[EHD] ve Periton Diyalizi[PD]), sundukları esneklik, artan hasta otonomisi ve potansiyel klinik avantajlar nedeniyle giderek daha fazla önem kazanmaktadır. Ancak, ECD böbrek nakli ile ev diyalizi tedavi seçeneklerinin uzun dönem sonuçlarının karşılaştırılması konusunda literatürde kısıtlı sayıda çalışma bulunmaktadır. Bu çalışmanın temel amacı, ECD böbrek nakli yapılan SDBY hastaları ile ev diyalizi (EHD) tedavisi gören SDBY hastalarının uzun dönem klinik sonuçlarını; özellikle hasta sağkalımı, tedaviye bağlı komplikasyonlar ve yaşam kalitesi açısından kapsamlı bir şekilde karşılaştırmaktır. Mevcut literatür incelendiğinde, bazı çalışmaların yoğun ev hemodiyalizi (IHHD) veya EHD hastalarının sağkalımının, kadaverik donörlerden (özellikle ECD) böbrek alan hastalarınkiyle benzer olabileceğine işaret ettiği görülmektedir(1). Bununla birlikte, canlı donör (LD) ve standart kriterli donör (SCD) KT'nin genellikle EHD'ye göre daha iyi sağkalım avantajı sunduğu belirtilmektedir(2). Tedavi başarısızlığı veya ölüm gibi kompozit sonuçlar açısından ise ECD naklinin dahi ev diyalizine üstün olabileceğine dair bulgular da mevcuttur. Bu çalışma, mevcut literatürdeki metodolojik sınırlılıkları ve özellikle sağkalım dışı hasta odaklı sonuçlardaki (malignite, kardiyovasküler hastalık vb.) bilgi eksikliğini gidermeyi hedeflemektedir. Elde edilecek bulguların, SDBY hastaları için tedavi modalitesi seçiminde klinisyenlere ve hastalara daha net, kanıta dayalı bir rehberlik sunması, bireyselleştirilmiş tedavi yaklaşımlarını desteklemesi ve sağlık politikalarının şekillendirilmesine katkıda bulunması beklenmektedir. Çalışmanın hipotezleri arasında, ECD böbrek nakli ile ev diyalizi arasında hasta sağkalımı açısından anlamlı bir fark olmayacağı, ancak yaşam kalitesi ve belirli komplikasyon profilleri açısından farklılıklar olacağı öngörülmektedir

makaleler.baslik: Real-world survival scenarios for patients with colorectal cancer and synchronous peritoneal metastases.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Senkron Peritoneal Metastazlı Kolorektal Kanserde Gerçek Dünya Sağkalım Senaryoları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Senkron peritoneal metastatik kolorektal kanserli 7038 hastayı içeren popülasyon tabanlı kohort çalışmasında, hastalar CRS-HIPEC, primer tümör rezeksiyonu, sistemik tedavi ve BSC gruplarına ayrılmıştır. CRS-HIPEC için medyan sağkalım 35 ay, üst tipik senaryo 68 ay ve en kötü senaryo 11 ay olarak bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Peritoneal metastases are present in nearly twenty-five percent of patients with synchronous metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Treatment related overall survival (OS) outcomes within a real-world mCRC cohort, unstratified by metastatic site, have shown controversial results compared with corresponding trials, underlining the importance of evaluating survival scenarios within a real-world population. Therefore, the current study quantified real-world survival scenarios for patients with synchronous peritoneal metastatic colorectal cancer (sCPM) for each treatment.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This population-based cohort study included all patients diagnosed with sCPM between 2011 and 2020. Patients were stratified based on therapeutic approach: Cytoreductive Surgery and Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy (CRS-HIPEC), Primary Tumor Resection (PTR) with or without palliative systemic therapy, Palliative Systemic Therapy (PST) and Best-Supportive Care (BSC). Primary outcomes were best, upper-typical, median, lower-typical and worst-case survival scenarios for each treatment, calculated from survival curve percentiles.
RESULTS: Of 7038 patients, 12% underwent CRS-HIPEC, 27% underwent PTR, 30% received PST and 2200 (31%) received BSC. For CRS-HIPEC, the best, upper-typical, median, lower-typical and worst-case scenarios were: not-reached, 68, 35, 20 and 11 months. For PTR, these scenarios were 51, 26, 13, 5.9 and 1.8 months, while for PST these were 28, 17, 10, 5.3 and 2.6 months. For BSC these scenarios were 7.1, 3.4, 1.5, 0.6 and 0.2 months.
CONCLUSIONS: Real-world treatment related OS scenarios demonstrate a considerable heterogeneity across, and within treatment modalities for patients with synchronous CPM. These findings provide more tailored treatment related expected OS. Moreover, OS outcomes are inferior to those reported in corresponding trials, emphasizing constraints of external validity in mCRC trials.
makaleler.dergi_tam: European journal of surgical oncology : the journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology

makaleler.baslik: Synoptic reporting of cytoreductive surgical procedures for patients with peritoneal malignancy based on the PSOGI-ESGO-ISSPP consensus.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Peritoneal Malignitelerde Sitoredüktif Cerrahi İçin Sinoptik Raporlama Konsensüsü
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Peritoneal maligniteler için sitoredüktif cerrahinin standardizasyonunu artırmak amacıyla Lyon konsensus çalışma grubu sinoptik raporlama formu geliştirmiştir. Bu form, cerrahi prosedürlerin, viseral rezeksiyonların ve Peritoneal Cancer Index detaylarının uniform bir şekilde kaydedilmesini sağlayarak araştırmaları kolaylaştırmayı hedefler.
makaleler.ozet: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS), for peritoneal malignancies (PM) is performed with the goal of achieving a CC-0 resection. However, the extent of peritonectomy and type of visceral resections (oncological versus non-oncological) performed during CRS vary among surgeons and lack standardization. The classification of peritonectomy procedures was revised by a consensus among some of the most experienced CRS surgeons in the world, defining the subdivisions and boundaries of each procedure. A format of documenting the extent of peritoneal resection was created which is an important research tool. To precisely report the extent and complexity of CRS, other aspects like the extent of exploration of the abdominal cavity and occult peritoneal spaces, the peritoneal disease extent and the visceral resections performed should be documented in a uniform manner. In the era of precision medicine, CRS needs to be standardized as much as possible. Thus, the working group for the Lyon consensus has created a form for synoptic reporting for CRS in an effort to further standardize CRS and facilitate future research. This form incorporates the surgical Peritoneal Cancer Index (PCI) including morphological appearance of PM, peritonectomy procedures and extent of peritoneal resection, visceral resections (oncological versus non-oncological), lymphadenectomy, extra-abdominal resections, abdominal wall resections, reconstruction procedures, and residual PCI. An online platform has been developed to generate structured operative reports incorporating all the details in this form (www.crs-report.com). Synoptic reporting will facilitate research and help define surgical strategies. It will help classify CRS according to its complexity clarifying formulation of recommendations for perioperative care.

makaleler.baslik: Long-term Outcomes of Surgery for Metastatic and Recurrent Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumours in the Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor Era: A 14-Year Single-Centre Experience from a Tertiary Cancer Centre in India.
makaleler.baslik_tr: TKI Döneminde Metastatik ve Rekürren GIST Cerrahisinin Uzun Dönem Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 14 yıllık süreçte metastatik veya rekürren GIST nedeniyle cerrahi uygulanan 75 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, medyan PFS 48 ay ve cerrahiye göre 5 yıllık genel sağkalım %81,4 olarak saptanmıştır. Mitotik indeks >5/50 HPF, inferior sağkalımı bağımsız olarak öngörmüştür (HR 4,85; p=0,013).
makaleler.ozet:
UNLABELLED: Across 75 patients undergoing surgery for metastatic or recurrent GIST over 14 years, complete resection integrated with TKI therapy was associated with durable disease control (median PFS 48 months; 5-year overall survival 81.4% anchored to surgery and 90.8% anchored to metastatic diagnosis). A mitotic index >5/50 HPF - a postoperative surrogate of intrinsic tumour biology - independently predicted inferior survival (HR 4.85; p=0.013).
BACKGROUND: Tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) have transformed the management of metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST); however, acquired resistance limits long-term disease control. The role of surgery in prolonging disease control remains uncertain.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study evaluated 75 patients who underwent surgery for metastatic or recurrent GIST between 2009 and 2023 at a high-volume tertiary referral cancer centre. Clinicopathological characteristics, operative outcomes, mutational profiles, and survival data were analysed. Overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Independent prognostic factors were identified using multivariable Cox regression. Subgroup analyses by disease presentation and sensitivity analyses for immortal-time bias were performed.
RESULTS: Among 75 patients (median age 54 years; 74.7% male), neoadjuvant TKI therapy was administered in 96% and R0 resection achieved in 97.3%; major morbidity (Clavien-Dindo ≥III) was 16% and perioperative mortality 1.3%. At a median follow-up of 86 months, 17 deaths were recorded; 5- and 10-year overall survival were 81.4% and 65.2% anchored to the date of surgery, and 90.8% and 73.3% anchored to metastatic diagnosis (median diagnosis-to-surgery interval 21 months); median PFS from surgery was 48 months (5-year PFS 37.7%). On multivariable analysis, a mitotic index >5/50 high-power fields (HPF) independently predicted inferior OS (HR 4.85; 95% CI 1.39-16.97; p=0.013) and PFS (HR 3.88; 95% CI 1.87-8.10; p<0.001); no other variable was independently associated with OS. Patients operated during radiological progression on TKI therapy (n=13) had significantly inferior overall survival compared with those resected after response or stabilisation (5-year OS 72.7% vs 94.6%; p=0.012). The mitotic-index association persisted in the surgery-anchored analysis (HR 5.10; 95% CI 1.46-17.86; p=0.005).
CONCLUSIONS: In this highly selected single-centre cohort, surgery integrated with TKI therapy was associated with durable disease control in selected patients with metastatic/recurrent GIST (surgery-anchored 5-year overall survival 81.4%). Mitotic index - a postoperative surrogate of intrinsic tumour biology - was the strongest independent adverse prognostic factor.

makaleler.baslik: Transanal local excision reduces surgical burden without evidence of increased recurrence in lower rectal GIST: a multicenter inverse probability of treatment weighting analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Alt Rektal GIST'te Transanal Lokal Eksizyonun Cerrahi Yüke Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Primer alt rektal GIST'li 101 hastanın değerlendirildiği çok merkezli çalışmada, IPTW ayarlı analizler transanal lokal eksizyonun transabdominal laparoskopik radikal rezeksiyona kıyasla daha kısa operatif süre (-118,4 dk; P<0,001) ve daha düşük geçici stoma oranı (OR 0,05; P<0,001) ile ilişkili olduğunu göstermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Lower rectal gastrointestinal stromal tumors (rGISTs) pose a surgical challenge, as complete resection must be balanced against anorectal function preservation. Transanal local excision (taLE) may offer a less invasive alternative to transabdominal laparoscopic radical resection (tlRR), but comparative evidence, particularly for larger tumors, is limited.
METHODS: We conducted a multicenter retrospective cohort study of patients with primary lower rGIST (lower tumor margin ≤ 5 cm from the anal verge; tumor size ≥ 2 cm and < 7 cm) undergoing taLE or tlRR (April 2015-April 2023). Inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) balanced baseline characteristics, and doubly robust models adjusted residual imbalance. Perioperative outcomes, recurrence-free survival (RFS), and a prespecified ≥ 5 cm subgroup analysis were evaluated.
RESULTS: Among 101 patients (taLE, n = 74; tlRR, n = 27; median follow-up, 40 months), IPTW-adjusted analyses showed significantly reduced surgical burden with taLE: shorter operative time (- 118.4 min, P < 0.001), lower postoperative pain (- 2.5, P < 0.001), earlier drain removal (- 5.1 days, P = 0.008), no permanent stoma (0/74 vs. 5/27), and lower odds of temporary stoma (OR 0.05, P < 0.001) and reoperation (OR 0.02, P = 0.009). These advantages remained largely consistent in the ≥ 5 cm subgroup. Only four recurrences occurred, with no significant RFS difference (log-rank P = 0.43); power was limited.
CONCLUSIONS: taLE was associated with substantially reduced surgical burden in selected patients with lower rGIST, and no significant difference in recurrence-free survival was observed during available follow-up. However, with only four events, the study was underpowered to establish oncologic equivalence. The taLE-based organ-preserving pathway may represent a promising option pending confirmation in larger cohorts.

makaleler.baslik: Predictors of Immediate Therapeutic Lymph Node Dissection Instead of Index Lymph Node After Neoadjuvant Checkpoint Inhibitors: Lessons Learned from the PRADO Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Neoadjuvan İmmünoterapi Sonrası Lenf Nodu Diseksiyonu Belirteçleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Makroskopik evre III melanom nedeniyle neoadjuvan ipilimumab ve nivolumab alan 99 hastanın incelendiği PRADO çalışması alt analizinde, 40 yaş altı olmak (OR 7,91; %95 CI 1,35-46,30; P=0,022) ve radyografik tümör boyutu artışı (OR 1,15; %95 CI 1,07-1,24; P<0,001) doğrudan terapeutik lenf nodu diseksiyonu ile ilişkili bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: In the PRADO trial, a multicenter phase II study, patients with macroscopic stage III melanoma received neoadjuvant ipilimumab and nivolumab followed by resection of the marked index lymph node (ILN). Patients without a major pathological response (MPR) underwent therapeutic lymph node dissection (TLND), although some required TLND for other indications. We investigated whether baseline clinicopathological and preoperative response parameters identify patients benefiting from immediate TLND rather than ILN resection followed by potential secondary TLND.
METHODS: Data were collected from PRADO case report forms. Group differences were assessed using Fisher's exact, chi-square, or Mann-Whitney U tests. Logistic regression identified predictors of TLND, with a subgroup analysis restricted to pathology-positive TLND. Model performance was assessed using (cross-validated) area under the receiver operating characteristic curve.
RESULTS: Ninety-nine patients were included; 36 underwent TLND: 20 (56%) with pathological nonresponse, eight (22%) with partial response, and eight (22%) for other indications (nodal recurrence after MPR, n = 3; extranodal extension, n = 1; suspicious nodes on imaging, n = 2; or infeasible ILN resection due to immune-related adverse events, n = 2). Age < 40 years (odds ratio 7.91, 95% confidence interval 1.35-46.30; P = 0.022) and radiographic increase in tumor size (odds ratio 1.15; 95% confidence interval 1.07-1.24; P < 0.001) were associated with TLND.
CONCLUSIONS: Age younger than 40 years and unfavorable radiological response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy were associated with TLND, suggesting these parameters may identify patients at risk of residual nodal disease and subsequent need for TLND.

tez.baslik: Ratlarda çekum perforasyonu ile oluşturulan peritonit modelinde oral resveratrol uygulamasının bakteriyel translokasyon ve inflamasyon üzerine etkilerinin değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: Çekum perforasyonu ile oluşturulan deneysel peritonit modelinde oral resveratrolün bakteriyel translokasyon ve inflamasyon üzerindeki etkileri incelenmiştir.
tez.ozet: Peritonit, gastrointestinal sistem perforasyonları sonucunda gelişebilen ve yüksek morbidite ile mortaliteye yol açabilen ciddi bir klinik tablodur. Deneysel peritonit modelleri içerisinde çekum perforasyonu, patofizyolojiyi en iyi taklit eden yöntemlerden biridir. Peritonit sürecinde bağırsak bariyer bütünlüğünün bozulması, bakteriyel translokasyona ve buna bağlı olarak sistemik inflamatuar yanıt sendromu (SIRS), sepsis ve çoklu organ yetmezliği gibi ağır komplikasyonlara neden olabilir. Resveratrol, doğal bir polifenol olup antioksidan, antiinflamatuar ve antimikrobiyal etkileri ile ön plana çıkmaktadır. Bu etkileri sayesinde resveratrol, inflamatuar süreçlerin düzenlenmesinde ve immün yanıtın modülasyonunda potansiyel bir tedavi ajanı olarak değerlendirilmektedir. Son yıllarda yapılan çalışmalarda, resveratrolün sepsis ve inflamasyonla ilişkili hayvan modellerinde olumlu etkiler gösterdiği bildirilmektedir. Ancak, oral yolla uygulanan resveratrolün deneysel peritonit modelinde bakteriyel translokasyon ve inflamatuar yanıt üzerindeki etkilerini değerlendiren yeterli sayıda çalışma bulunmamaktadır. Bu çalışmanın amacı; çekum perforasyonu ile oluşturulan deneysel peritonit modelinde, oral yolla uygulanan resveratrolün bakteriyel translokasyon ve sistemik inflamasyon üzerine etkilerini değerlendirmektir. Bu kapsamda, resveratrolün TNF-α ve IL-6 gibi proinflamatuar sitokin düzeyleri ile karaciğer, dalak, mezenterik lenf nodu ve kan kültürlerinde bakteriyel üreme üzerindeki etkileri araştırılacaktır.
